title: Senior Account Executive - Automotive
description:
Job Title: Senior Account Executive 

Type: Full-time 

Experience: 5+ years 

What about us? 

Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas. 

At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents. 

By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide. 

Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation 🚀 

The Role 

As a Senior Account Executive at INFINIT, you will own revenue generation, focusing on winning high-value, strategic new-business opportunities. You will engage with senior stakeholders, navigate complex sales cycles, and create tailored value propositions that showcase how INFINIT’s AI-driven fintech platform transforms business operations. 

We are looking for a high-performing hunter with a strong track record of closing larger deals, managing multi-stakeholder relationships, and driving high-impact commercial outcomes. 

What do we want to achieve together? 

- You will own the full sales cycle, from strategic prospecting to negotiation and closing, with a primary focus on acquiring large, high-value customers particularly automotive clients such as car dealerships

- You will act as a catalyst for innovation in large-account acquisition, identifying new growth opportunities and emerging verticals, particularly within the dealership ecosystem.

- You will design and execute outbound strategies tailored to key account leads, with an emphasis on automotive dealership prospects.

- You will build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers within key account prospects understanding their unique operational needs and aligning them with INFINIT’s solutions.

- You will collaborate closely with Product, and Customer Success teams to deliver seamless and impactful customer journeys for dealership clients.

- You will drive commercial strategy and contribute to refining our value proposition for the automotive segment and other large verticals.

What do you need to be successful in this role? 

- 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including proven success selling into mid-market or enterprise accounts.

- Demonstrated ability to run and close complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with deal sizes significantly above SMB level.

- Strong communication, negotiation, and executive-level presentation skills.A hunter mentality: proactive, resourceful, and relentless in pursuing large opportunities.

- Experience thriving in fast-paced startup or scale-up environments with evolving processes.

- Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail; comfortable using CRM and sales intelligence tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).

- Ability to work cross-functionally with Customer Success and Operations to ensure a seamless customer handover and long-term success.

What will you find working at INFINIT? 

- Competitive Salary and Equity : We offer highly competitive salaries and a stake in our success with share options because we're building this together.

- Diverse and Inclusive Team : Join a dynamic and international team in excess of 8 nationalities. You'll have the chance to work with experienced professionals from around the world, fostering a rich learning environment.

- Inspiring Mission : We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities.

- Health and Well-being: Your health matters to us. You will have access to top-quality Medical & Mental Health Insurance.

- Quality Time Together : We foster a sense of community with annual gatherings and bi-weekly office team gatherings. You're more than welcome to join us for quality time.

- Personal Time Off : Enjoy flexibility with your personal time off.

- Flexibility and Ownership : We trust our team and we are goal-oriented. Enjoy the flexibility of remote working with occasional central venue gatherings.

Diversity and Inclusion 

INFINIT promotes an inclusive culture that seeks equity and values different perspectives. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

FAYN Supplements steht für höchste Qualität und innovative Produkte im Bereich Nahrungsergänzungsmittel. - Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem jungen Team

title: Mitarbeiter Kundenservice B2C FinTech (m/w/d)
description:
Konto. Karte. Fertig. Los. 

Nickel ist 2014 in Frankreich entstanden und seitdem DIE Zahlungslösung, die es jedem ermöglicht, innerhalb von nur wenigen Minuten in einer Tabak- oder Lottoannahmestelle ein Girokonto zu eröffnen und direkt eine Karte zu erhalten.

Mit 5 Millionen eröffneten Konten und 12.000 Verkaufsstellen, die in kleine Filialen umgewandelt wurden, ist Nickel eine echte europäische Erfolgsgeschichte.

Mit mehr als 850 Mitarbeitenden in Paris, Nantes, Madrid, Lissabon, Brüssel und Berlin beschleunigt Nickel seine internationale Entwicklung. Wir haben 2021 in Spanien, 2022 in Belgien und Portugal begonnen und sind 2023 in Deutschland gestartet.

Aufgaben

Um unseren Privatkundinnen und Privatkunden das bestmögliche Erlebnis zu bieten, suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt ein neues Teammitglied in Berlin.

Zu deinen Aufgaben zählen: 

- Bearbeite gewissenhaft und präzise die Anfragen von Aufsichtsbehörden und Gerichten

- Überprüfe die Zahlungstransfer und Kontobewegungen unserer Kundinnen und Kunden und melde verdächtige Aktivitäten bei der internen Compliance Abteilung

- Du bist Ansprechperson für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bei Anfragen nach der Kontoeröffnung

- Verbessere maßgeblich unseren Service, indem du aktiv Kundenfeedback einholst, auswertest und eine zufriedenstellende Lösung findest

- Du agierst als kommunikative Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kunden, internen Abteilungen und 1st Level Call Center

- Sei unser Jack-of-all-Trades und supporte deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen da wo es gerade nötig ist

Qualifikation

Folgendes bringst du mit: 

- Berufliche Erfahrung im Kundenservice, idealerweise im Finanzumfeld, Inbound-Call Center oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich

- Erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Gerichten, Finanz- und Aufsichtsbehörden sowie Bearbeitung von Auskunftsersuchen oder Pfändungen sind von Vorteil

- Proaktive, selbstständige und serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise mit Fokus auf Kundenzufriedenheit und Mehrwert

- Starke Kontakt- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten

- Gewinnermentalität: Du bist bereit schnell zu lernen, Dinge voranzutreiben und die Extrameile für dich und dein Team zu gehen

- Sicherer Umgang mit den gängigen Office Programmen und erste Erfahrung mit Ticketing-Tools (z.B. Zendesk)

- Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist von Vorteil

Du erfüllst nicht zu 100% alle Anforderungen an das gesuchte Profil? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir bieten Herausforderungen um daraus zu lernen und Platz für Wachstum. 

Benefits

Wir bieten dir: 

- Ein gutes Grundgerüst - 30 Tage Urlaub, ein unbefristeter Vertrag und ein tolles Büro im Herzen von Berlin

- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (bis zu 2 Tagen Home Office pro Woche)

- Dein Engagement wird belohnt - wir versichern dir ein attraktives Gehaltspaket

- eGym-Wellpass Zugang, ÖPNV-Zuschuss, Essenszuschuss, Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Versicherungs- sowie Vermögenswirksame Leistungen und Corporate Benefits Vergünstigungen

- Regelmäßige Team-Events & Company Offsites, um gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern

- Fort- und Weiterbildungen für dein persönliches Vorankommen

Bewirb dich jetzt mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung über unser Bewerbungsportal.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Console GPU Inference
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment? 

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

What you’ll be doing 

- You will take partial ownership of the design and delivery of critical software components powering different types of runtime machine learning inference on the PlayStation consoles. title: Screening and Escalations Senior Payment Analyst
description:
Trust unlocks our greatest potential. 

For decades, the clearing of payments remained unchanged and unchallenged. We asked, what if there was a better way? What if we could make banking infrastructure faster, safer, more reliable, and easier to access for all? Here is where you can think radically and responsibly to find the best solution.

What happens when you know you’re inherently trusted? Trust creates safety. Safety encourages you to be brave, to challenge, to fail, to try new things and to execute. At ClearBank everything revolves around trust. We’re not expected to earn it, but we are expected not to break it. We’re trusted to own it. To solve issues in the moment. To know a good risk when we see one, and the judgement to know that ‘can’ doesn’t always mean you ‘should’.

What you can expect: 

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

If that excites you, how about joining our 1st line Financial Crime Operations team as a Screening and Escalations Senior Payment Analyst? Reporting into the Senior Manager, FCO Screening & Escalations you will be responsible for the oversight and investigation system-generated payment screening alerts. You’ll act as a subject matter expert for payment screening across our client base. You’ll also have an excellent understanding of financial crime typologies and detection methods and share this knowledge with Analysts within the team.

This role is critical in ensuring our compliance with anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and protecting the integrity of our financial systems. You’ll be raising concerns and providing ideas, engaging with clients, and making informed decisions with your sound knowledge of payment services; excellent technical and regulatory knowledge across financial crime and sanctions within the UK and EEA, including reporting requirements, and you’ll have a firm understanding of how to identify and mitigate risks within a business.

Your role includes: 

- Analysing and investigating system-generated alerts related to payment screening. You will use existing information or request information from clients and 3rd parties to support discounting of the alert.

- Analysing transactions to identify suspicious activities and potential money laundering risks

- Assessing internal and external intelligence to identify financial crime risk and escalate as appropriate. Where relevant you will raise internal Suspicious Activity Reports (iSARs)

- Ensuring all investigations and processes comply with relevant AML laws and regulations

- Acting as a first point of escalation for Payment Screening Analysts

- Managing escalations and senior management conversations in both first and second lines of defence

- Allocating tasks, assisting in oversight and prioritisation to ensure any deadlines are met

- Staying up to date on the latest AML trends, emerging typologies and best practices to enhance the effectiveness of our screening systems

- Maintaining detailed records of investigations and ensuring timely resolution of cases

- Following ClearBank procedures & standards, raising and escalating relevant reports where required to ensure compliance with relevant AML laws and regulation

What you’ll bring: 

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

- Solid and demonstrated experience in AML, financial crime investigations, or a related field

- Strong knowledge across all forms of sanctions typologies e.g. Trade Sanctions, dual use goods, Personal and Professional enablers, payments involving complex structures

- Good knowledge of sectors such as money remittance, electronic money, and cryptocurrency firms would be beneficial

- Lead through vision, values, and model leadership behaviours while championing and facilitating change.

Self-starter who can proactively influence clients to help evolve best practices and drive innovation.

- Integrated Perspective: Strong understanding of how Paid Search and Paid Social integrate into overall cross-channel campaign strategy and the wider media landscape.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

What is the opportunity?

Every go-to-market decision at Intercom, who we target, who owns the account, what we know about them, what we should say next - rests on a foundation of account and contact data. Getting that foundation right is one of the highest-leverage engineering problems in the company: a single account hierarchy fix can re-route territory, pipeline credit and forecast for thousands of accounts at once.

This role owns that foundation. You will build and run the systems that decide what an account is , resolving duplicates, stitching subsidiaries into corporate hierarchies, sourcing new accounts and contacts into our CRM, and enriching them with firmographic, technographic and intent signals. Someone who gets energy from a rep saying "this list is exactly right" and from watching a pipeline they built turn into revenue.

What will I be doing?

- Owning account identity. Building and improving the entity-resolution layer that decides when two records are the same company: domain and firmographic matching, confidence scoring, and the merge/dedupe pipelines that keep Salesforce clean at scale.

- Modelling account hierarchy. Designing the organisation spine that links accounts to their parent, top operating parent and ultimate corporate parent.

- Building account sourcing pipelines. Turning market definitions into ranked, deduplicated, CRM-ready account lists: sourcing from third-party and internal signals, scoring fit, and pushing accounts into Salesforce with the right owner and the right metadata.

- Building contact sourcing and enrichment pipelines. Finding the right people at target accounts, verifying and enriching them, respecting privacy and consent requirements, and delivering them into the tools reps and marketers actually work in.

- Building LLM-powered enrichment. Extending our enrichment framework — LLM jobs with web search and crawling tools across multiple providers, to answer questions no vendor sells: what support channels does this company run, are they hiring CS or sales roles, do they ship an AI product, how ready are they for Fin.

- Making the data usable. Landing everything in well-modelled, well-tested dbt models in Snowflake orchestrated in Airflow, and syncing it out to Salesforce, Marketo, Clay and the rest of the GTM stack.

- Owning quality and trust. Instrumenting your pipelines with tests, alerts and reconciliation so problems surface before a rep finds them, and being the person GTM comes to when a number looks wrong.

- Partnering on the problem, not the ticket. Sitting with Sales, Marketing and Ops to understand what they are actually trying to do, then proposing the data foundation that unlocks it.

- A genuine interest in growing the business and a real affinity for GTM teams. You are curious about how sales and marketing work, comfortable in a room full of reps, and motivated by commercial outcomes rather than only technical ones.

- Experience with the modern data stack: dbt, a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake), and a DAG orchestrator (we use Airflow).

- Experience building with LLMs in production: prompt design and evaluation, tool/function calling, web search and crawling, cost and latency control.

- Experience with entity resolution, identity or deduplication problems — matching messy real-world records, and reasoning about precision/recall trade-offs where a false merge has a real business cost.

- Hands-on experience integrating with SaaS APIs and business systems, especially Salesforce: reading from them, writing back to them.

- Strong communication: you can explain a hierarchy change to a CRO and a merge heuristic to an engineer, on the same day.

- A growth mindset and eagerness to learn — the tooling in this space is changing fast.

Nice to haves

- Experience with GTM data vendors and tooling — ZoomInfo, Apollo, Clearbit, Clay, Crossbeam, Marketo, Census/Fivetran, Gong.

- Experience with territory design, account scoring, propensity models or ICP definition.

- Exposure to privacy and compliance considerations around contact data (GDPR, CCPA, consent management).

From accessibility and SEO/AIO to analytics and content intelligence, our Agentic Content Intelligence Platform enables organizations to create, govern, and optimize digital content that is compliant, discoverable, and effective at scale.

- Own the full sales cycle for named enterprise accounts, driving both new logo acquisition and expansion opportunities within your territory

- 5+ years of SaaS sales experience with a strong track record in new business and/or account growth

- Fluency in German (written and spoken), with experience selling into the DACH market strongly preferred

- Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles

- Experience engaging senior and executive stakeholders (CMO, CDO, CIO, and equivalent roles)

- Strong commercial acumen with the ability to build, forecast, and close large, strategic deals

- Collaborative mindset with a strong bias for action, learning, and cross-functional partnership

- High resilience, adaptability, and performance orientation in a fast-paced environment

title: Chief of Staff, Strategic Growth & Partnerships (UK)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team 

We are seeking a strategic, highly commercial and growth-driven Chief of Staff to spearhead commercial expansion and high-priority strategic initiatives in the UK market. Sitting directly alongside the UK CEO, this role bridges establishing high-value institutional partnerships with executive-level project execution.

This is a high-leverage commercial and sales-focused Chief of Staff role - not an internal, project management or administration-focused role. Moving beyond traditional sales or purely operational roles, this position is designed for a strategic partner. You will act as the UK CEO’s right hand contributing to the long-term strategy, originating institutional partnerships and owning cross-functional strategic projects with the CEO end-to-end. A core element of this role is driving commercial growth alongside the UK CEO. This includes fully grasping the broader landscape, market and competitor dynamics, customer behaviour and regulatory context into actionable strategies for Group-level product and executive leadership.

Your Responsibilities 

Strategic Business Development & Commercial Growth 

- Market & Commercial Strategy: Act as the local market strategist, translating UK client context, competitive dynamics, and customer feedback into growth opportunities and clear requirements for leadership.

- Execute on this Strategy and Drive Partner Origination & Platform Growth: Lead business development initiatives to identify and execute commercial partnerships with banks, asset managers, wealth managers and myriad financial institutions across the UK.

- Executive Sales Support: Partner directly with the UK CEO on complex commercial partnership negotiations.

- Deal Structuring & Financial Modeling: Evaluate commercial frameworks, conduct quantitative modeling, and negotiate terms for strategic accounts and commercial initiatives.

Strategic Operations & Cross-Functional Execution

- Strategic Project Management: Own and drive end-to-end execution of CEO-led strategic initiatives, ensuring cross-functional alignment across local teams and the wider Raisin Group.

- Executive & Board Preparation: Draft strategic presentations, business cases, and commercial proposals for the UK CEO, Boards (local and Group), and Group executive management.

- Product Roadmap Alignment: Collaborate with Group product and operational teams to champion UK commercial priorities and integrate required features into the product roadmap.

- Structured Execution: Maintain rigorous documentation, project cadences, and operational alignment across all UK strategic priorities while navigating Risk, Compliance, and Legal clearance for new commercial structures.

Your Profile 

Qualifications & Experience 

- A background in Investment Banking (especially FIG), M&A Advisory, Corporate Finance, Consulting or Strategic BD experience in financial services/fintech is highly desirable.

- Highly analytical and proactive mindset, avoiding reactive "firefighting" in favor of methodical, structured, data-backed execution and strategic planning.

Essential Skills & Core Competencies 

- Strategic acumen: strong commercial instincts and a thorough appreciation for UK market dynamics.

- Commercial & Financial Rigour: Strong financial modeling, valuation, contract negotiation, and analytical skills honed in high-pressure environments.

- Stakeholder Management & Influence: Proven ability to influence, challenge, and align internal Group stakeholders, C-suite executives, and external partners.

- Versatility: Comfortable pivoting seamlessly between financial modeling, client-facing sales meetings, and internal project coordination.

- Communication: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills suited for Board level interaction and external partner pitching.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! 

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

- Employee Development Budget of £1,700 and 4 full training days per year.

- Always hungry? Breakfast, snacks, daily fresh fruit and drinks are at your disposal around the clock.

- We are hybrid working, we are in the office twice a week, giving the team the opportunity to collaborate and spend time together. Wednesday is our core day in the office.

- We offer 28 days + Bank Holidays of holiday a year.

title: Senior Marketing Manager (International Growth)
description:
Shape How the World Discovers Hospitality with OpenTable 

Are you a strategic marketer who thrives at the intersection of high-impact brand media and performance growth? Do you want the agility, ownership, and speed of a tech startup, backed by the scale and resources of a global industry leader? 

With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion. 

Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture. 

A little about the role... 

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Marketing Manager to lead upper-funnel brand media and help scale our growth across international markets. 

You’ll take strategic ownership of international brand investment, shape channel strategies across Out-of-Home (OOH), Connected TV (CTV) and digital video, and play an important role in defining how we grow and reach diners internationally. 

This is a role with plenty of scope to think big, test ideas and get hands-on with making them happen. 

Why this role is unique; 

- Startup autonomy, enterprise scale: Build systems, test new channels and move quickly, while having the backing of world-class data, resources and an established global brand. 

- True end-to-end ownership: From building investment cases and managing agency relationships to designing lift studies and getting hands-on with execution, you’ll have real ownership of the outcome. 

- Cross-functional influence: You’ll bring together media agencies, regional market leads, performance marketing, creative partners and adtech engineering teams to make sure everyone is moving in the same direction. 

- Room to grow: As our International Growth practice continues to scale, there’s an opportunity for your remit and leadership responsibilities to grow with it. 

📈 What you’ll drive; 

- International Brand Media Strategy: Own the end-to-end strategy, channel selection and investment allocation for upper-funnel activity across key international markets, including OOH, CTV and digital video. 

- Full-Funnel Growth: Connect brand media with performance channels, CRM, organic and social to create a seamless diner journey and maximise ROI. 

- Advanced Brand Measurement: Move beyond last-click attribution by establishing frameworks for lift studies, brand tracking and econometrics to better understand and optimise the impact of international investment. 

- Cross-Functional Growth Systems: Partner with creative and engineering teams to build campaign infrastructure and explore how AI-powered tooling can help us move faster across markets. 

- Executive Leadership Alignment: Turn complex media and growth insights into clear strategies, business cases and roadmaps that help senior leaders make informed decisions. 

- Test, Learn and Scale: Spot opportunities, test ideas quickly, learn from the results and scale what works. 

👋 Our ideal candidate... 

- You bring proven experience in integrated, brand or growth marketing, ideally in-house within a consumer tech brand or high-growth international business. 

- You’ve directly planned and executed campaigns across upper-funnel channels, such as OOH, CTV, linear TV or digital video, and understand how to measure their incremental impact. 

- You understand how brand, paid digital, CRM, content and product growth work together, and you’re equally comfortable thinking about the big picture and getting into the detail. 

- You have an owner’s mindset. When you spot an opportunity or something that could work better, you’re comfortable taking the initiative and finding a solution. 

- You know how to scale campaigns across multiple countries or regions and enjoy collaborating across different markets, cultures and time zones. 

- And finally, you love dining. You’re genuinely excited by restaurants, hospitality and the unique energy of dining culture. 🍽️ 

What we can offer you... 

- 5 weeks paid vacation 

- Private health & dental insurance 

- Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year 

- Focus on mental health and well-being: 

- Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth 

- Company-paid subscription to Headspace 

- Annual company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!) 

- Paid parental leave 

- Time off for your birthday 

- Paid volunteer time 

- Focus on your career growth: 

- Development Dollars 

- Leadership development 

- Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings 

- Travel Discounts 

- Employee Resource Groups 

- Income protection and life assurance 

- Employee Assistance Program - including 24/7 GP & free legal advice 

- Pension plan contributions 

- Discounted gym membership 

- Bike2Work 

- Season ticket loan 

- Social events & Thursday happy hours 

- Free lunch 2 days per week

This role aligns with that approach, with an expectation of coming into the office two days a week—giving employees the best of both worlds: in-person collaboration and flexibility. 

Work Environment & Flexibility 

At OpenTable, we pride ourselves on fostering a global and dynamic work environment. title: Neuroscientist
description:

The Role 

Netholabs is building AI grounded in biological intelligence. We record petascale, high-resolution neurobehavioural data from living systems and use it to train neural foundation models — a new substrate for the next generation of AI, robotics, and personalised intelligence. We aim to greatly reduce the burden of animals used in basic scientific research and pharmacological work, with eventual removal and replacement by in silico models.

We're looking for a Neuroscientist to join our Brighton research team as an independent contributor driving experiments from design through analysis. You'll design and run in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural experiments, work with large-scale neural and behavioural datasets, and partner closely with our ML team to translate what we learn about real brains and bodies into better foundation models. This is a role for someone who wants their science to feed directly into what gets built next.

Responsibilities 

In Vivo Electrophysiology & Neural Recording 

- Design and run in vivo electrophysiology experiments in animal models

- Develop and refine neural recording protocols and rigs alongside the hardware team

- Ensure recordings meet the quality and fidelity standards our models are trained on

Behavioural Neuroscience & Experimental Design 

- Design behavioural paradigms that generate rich, well-controlled datasets

- Plan and oversee data collection sessions, in collaboration with technicians

- Iterate on experimental design based on data quality and downstream modelling needs

Data Analysis & Computational Modelling 

- Analyse large-scale neural and behavioural datasets

- Build and apply computational models to characterise neural and behavioural dynamics

- Validate findings and communicate results clearly to the broader research team

Neuroscience → AI Translation 

- Partner with the ML team to translate biological findings into model design choices

- Help define what neurobehavioural data and features are most valuable to capture

- Contribute to internal research direction connecting neuroscience and foundation model development

Requirements 

Core (essential) 

- BSc/MSc in neuroscience, behavioural sciences, or a related field, with hands-on experimental research experience. 

- Preferred: PhD and experience with in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural neuroscience experiments 

- Strong data analysis skills, including experience with Python or a similar language

- Able to design rigorous experiments and think critically about data quality

- Excellent communication; comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering and ML teams

Valued (or willing to learn) 

- Experience with large-scale or multi-modal neurobehavioural datasets

- Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals or foundation model training

- Experience with computational modelling of neural or behavioural data

- Prior work bridging neuroscience and AI/robotics research

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense . Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale. 

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). 

Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense . Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. 

Tu auras pour mission de : 

- Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. 

- Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. 

- Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. 

- Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. 

- Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. 

- Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. 

Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : 

- Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. 

- Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs. 

- Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive. 

- Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…). 

- Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique. 

- Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles. 

- Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu. 

- Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit. 

- Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine). 

C'est un plus si : 

- Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires. 

- Tu parles anglais. 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

- Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés. 

- Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires. 

- Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client. 

- Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence. 

- Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers… 

Processus de recrutement : 

- Entretien téléphonique RH. 

- Entretien avec le manager. 

- Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif. 

- Entretien final avec la Direction. 

Localisation : Montagnat (01) et Aix-en-Provence, avec 1 jour par semaine sur chaque site et 3 jours de télétravail. 

Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable

title: Planning and Supply Chain Manager
description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

At Quandela, we're moving from an R&D-driven organization toward a structured, scalable industrial operation. We're looking for a builder as much as a manager to create our end-to-end supply chain, from demand to customer delivery. Your first major challenge: build our S&OP process from the ground up. You'll move easily between strategy and execution, from running an S&OP review and an 18-month capacity outlook to solving a critical component shortage or securing an urgent customer shipment. 

Your Key Responsibilities 

- Build the S&OP process from scratch: define governance, meeting cadence, roles, inputs and KPIs, then progressively mature it as the company scales 
- Lead monthly cross-functional S&OP reviews with Sales, Operations, Production, R&D, Purchasing, Finance and Management, and establish a single shared view of demand, supply and customer commitments
- Consolidate demand from customer orders, weighted commercial forecasts, internal R&D needs, qualification activities and strategic programs into a rolling forecast
- Build and maintain the Master Production Schedule, with planning horizons adapted to our long manufacturing and supply lead times
- Translate demand into capacity, resource, material and supplier requirements, identify gaps and develop scenarios to support management decisions on priorities and commitments
- Turn the production plan into executable schedules, monitor WIP and progress, and coordinate recovery plans when delays or shortages occur
- Structure purchasing and MRP processes, define sourcing strategies based on lead time, criticality, supply risk, cost and MOQ, and track supplier performance (OTD, quality, responsiveness)
- Define inventory principles and safety-stock strategies for critical components, while managing excess, obsolete and slow-moving stock
- Organize inbound, internal and outbound logistics, including the transport of fragile, sensitive and high-value technological products
- Manage customs and international trade: import/export documentation, classification, country of origin, Incoterms and compliance, in coordination with forwarders and brokers
- Contribute to the selection and deployment of ERP/MRP and planning tools, reduce reliance on manual spreadsheets and build clear supply chain dashboards
- Define and track key KPIs (forecast accuracy, plan adherence, supplier and customer OTD/OTIF, inventory turns, shortages, lead times) and drive continuous improvement
Requirements 

- Master's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Engineering or a related field 
- 5+ years of experience in planning, supply chain or industrial operations
- Proven experience implementing or running an S&OP process 
- APICS / ASCM certification (CPIM, CSCP)
- Strong command of demand and production planning, scheduling, MRP, purchasing, inventory management and logistics 
- Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP systems
- Strong analytical skills and ability to turn complex data into clear priorities and decisions
- Excellent communication and cross-functional coordination skills
- Thrives in a fast-changing, growing organization
- Fluent French and English 
Nice to have 

- Experience in semiconductor, photonics, electronics or other high-tech manufacturing
- Foundries, outsourced manufacturing and long-lead-time, critical-component supply chains
- International suppliers and customers, customs and international logistics
- ERP implementation or supply chain digitalization; advanced Excel or Power BI 
Benefits 

- Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience 
- Profit-sharing & company savings plan
- 100% health coverage (Alan)
- 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
- Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
- Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer: 

- A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
- A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
- A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
- Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process 

- Talent Acquisition Interview (45')
- Hiring Manager Interview (45')
- Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
- Meeting with the teams 
- 2 reference check
- Offer 
(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles) 

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

As our manufacturing moves from R&D and low-volume production toward structured, scalable industrial output, we're looking for a hands-on Lean engineer who combines strong analytical skills with a pragmatic shop-floor mindset. You'll adapt Lean intelligently to a complex high-tech environment (long cycle times, expensive equipment, cleanroom and yield constraints) and help us manufacture faster, more reliably and at greater scale, without compromising quality or innovation.

- Define and deploy Lean principles across our semiconductor, photonic and system manufacturing, adapting them intelligently to a complex, low-volume/high-mix environment

Rattaché.e au Global Service Center Manager, vous êtes référent métier Supply Chain & Inventory à l'échelle globale. Vous garantissez la fiabilité, la performance et l'harmonisation des processus, des outils et des pratiques au sein du réseau de Service Centers (SAV Robotique). Vous êtes également responsable de la disponibilité des pièces, de la maîtrise des stocks et de leur optimisation afin de soutenir les objectifs de performance opérationnelle et financière.

Missions : 

Gérer les approvisionnements et les stocks à l’échelle globale 

- Superviser les flux critiques de planification et d'approvisionnement afin de garantir la disponibilité des pièces.
- Valider les propositions d'ordres de transfert et suivre les encours critiques.
- Définir et piloter les processus de Demand Planning et de réapprovisionnement afin d'assurer la cohérence entre prévisions, besoins opérationnels et niveaux de stock.
- Être force de proposition sur les stratégies d'approvisionnement et d'optimisation des stocks.
- Garantir la disponibilité des pièces tout en maîtrisant les coûts associés et les niveaux d'inventaire.
- Piloter les actions de réduction des stocks dormants et obsolètes.
- Définir les stratégies de gestion du cycle de vie des pièces et de prévention de l'obsolescence.
- Définir les standards de performance logistique et accompagner les équipes locales dans le suivi des partenaires transport.
- Soutenir les équipes locales dans la résolution des situations complexes.
Développer l’excellence opérationnelle Supply Chain 

- Garantir la cohérence, l'efficacité et la performance des processus Supply Chain au sein de l'ensemble des Service Centers.
- Définir, formaliser et déployer les standards métiers en matière de Supply Chain, de gestion des stocks et de planification.
- Animer les démarches d'amélioration continue des pratiques logistiques, d'approvisionnement et de gestion des stocks.
- Identifier les écarts de performance, analyser leurs causes racines et piloter les plans d'actions associés.
- Promouvoir le partage des bonnes pratiques et le retour d'expérience entre les différentes régions.
Être le référent des outils et systèmes 

- Agir en tant que Super Key User des outils Supply Chain, Inventory et Logistique (SAP, DDMRP, Power BI et outils associés).
- Assurer le paramétrage métier, la cohérence des données de référence et le respect des standards de gestion.
- Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l'adoption et l'utilisation optimale des outils.
- Développer et maintenir les supports de formation ainsi que la documentation métier.
- Contribuer à la définition de la roadmap fonctionnelle des outils en collaboration avec les équipes IT, Data et métiers.
- Identifier les opportunités de digitalisation et d'automatisation des processus Supply Chain.
Piloter la performance Supply Chain 

- Être garant de l'atteinte des objectifs mondiaux de disponibilité des pièces, de valeur de stock, de rotation des stocks et de réduction des stocks obsolètes.
- Animer les revues de performance Supply Chain avec les différentes régions et assurer le suivi des plans d'actions associés.
- Définir et suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) Supply Chain.
- Faire évoluer les tableaux de bord et outils de pilotage en collaboration avec les équipes Data.
- Analyser les tendances, identifier les risques opérationnels et les opportunités d'amélioration.
- Proposer et piloter les actions correctives permettant d'améliorer la disponibilité des pièces, le niveau de service et la maîtrise des stocks.
- Assurer un reporting régulier auprès du management.
Piloter les projets stratégiques Supply Chain 

- Conduire ou contribuer aux projets structurants liés aux processus, aux outils, à la gestion des stocks et à l'organisation logistique.
- Coordonner le déploiement de nouvelles solutions, méthodologies et évolutions systèmes.
- Participer aux projets de transformation majeurs (ERP, hubs logistiques, optimisation des stocks, Demand Planning, digitalisation des processus, etc.).
- Assurer l'alignement entre les besoins opérationnels des Service Centers et les objectifs stratégiques de l'entreprise.
- Mesurer les bénéfices des projets déployés et garantir l'atteinte des résultats attendus.

- Diplôme d'ingénieur.e ou formation équivalente en Supply Chain, Logistique ou Génie Industriel.
- Minimum 4 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions Supply Chain, approvisionnement, planification ou gestion des stocks avec une forte dimension opérationnelle et projet, dans un environnement international (idéalement multisites)
- Excellente maîtrise des processus Supply Chain et de gestion des stocks.
- Bonne connaissance des principes de Demand Planning, Forecasting et Inventory Management.

- Maîtrise avancée d'Excel, Power BI et des outils d'analyse de données (BigQuery apprécié).

title: CDI - CREATIVE DESIGNER (H/F)
description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS 

Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. 

Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. 

Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). 

Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). 

VOTRE RÔLE 

Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact.

VOS MISSIONS 

- Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion.

- Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison.

- Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés.

- Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image.

- Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison.

- Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…).

- Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations.

- Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants.

- Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports.

- Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication.

VOTRE PROFIL 

- Excellente culture graphique et artistique.

- Très forte maîtrise de l'identité visuelle, de la typographie et des systèmes graphiques.

- Capacité à développer des concepts créatifs.

- Excellente maîtrise de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects et Premiere.

- Aisance avec Keynote et PowerPoint.

- Très bonne maîtrise du motion design.

- Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création.

- Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes.

Le poste est situé rue de Lisbonne dans le 8è arrondissement de Paris.

title: Product Marketing Director
location: UK, Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Austria, Spain, Finland, USA. Some travel to our offices will be required from time-to-time
description:
Product Marketing Director 

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer 

Location: UK, France, Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Austria, Spain, Finland, USA. Some travel to our offices will be required from time-to-time

You must have the right to work in one the above countries in order to be considered for the role.

💼 About the role 

PQShield is looking for a Product Marketing Director who can turn complex technology into stories that people understand, remember, and act on.

You will own how PQShield's products, technology, and vision are positioned, communicated, and brought to market worldwide. You'll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, sales, customers, and the broader security market — translating breakthrough cryptography and security technology into compelling narratives for executives, engineers, partners, and buyers.

This role is for a strategic product marketer and exceptional storyteller who can identify the market shift, understand the customer problem, and turn complex technology into differentiated positioning that creates urgency, preference and demand. 

Since NIST published its first post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, which the PQShield team co-authored, organizations across semiconductors, automotive, defense, and enterprise face significant challenges in preparing for the post-quantum transition. This role will help define the market narrative around that transition, position PQShield's portfolio within it and give customers a clear reason to act.

⚒️ What you’ll be doing 

- Own the story: Develop the narrative, positioning, messaging, and value propositions that explain what is changing in the market, why customers need to act, the problem PQShield solves, and why our approach is differentiated.

- Turn technical capability into customer value: Work with cryptographers, engineers and product leaders to understand sophisticated technology, identify what matters to the buyer and translate technical capabilities into clear business and security value without sacrificing technical credibility.

- Position the portfolio: Own positioning and messaging for our hardware IP and software portfolio, including PQPlatform, PQPerform, PQCryptoLib, and PQMicroLib. Build a clear messaging architecture that connects the portfolio while preserving the differentiated value of each offering.

- Understand the customer: Develop deep insight into customer problems, buying journeys, security requirements, regulatory pressures, barriers to adoption, buying dynamics, and the forces driving post-quantum adoption. Turn those insights into sharper products, messaging, and go-to-market strategies.

- Shape category and market narrative: Help define how PQShield talks about post-quantum security, cryptographic agility, and the transition to quantum-safe systems — and how we differentiate our approach in a rapidly evolving market.

- Lead product launches: Create and execute compelling go-to-market strategies for new products, certifications, partnerships, and major releases.

- Equip the sales team: Build compelling presentations, stories, solution briefs, case studies, battlecards, and other tools that help sales teams communicate value and win complex deals.

- Build buyer and segment-specific stories: Develop differentiated narratives for semiconductors, automotive, military and aerospace, industrial IoT, networking, and enterprise, adapting the value story for different buyers, use cases and business priorities.

- Own competitive storytelling: Understand the competitive landscape and turn technical and commercial differences into clear, credible differentiation.

- Create exceptional content: Lead the development of white papers, thought leadership, application notes, customer stories, executive content, web experiences, and other material that establishes PQShield as a category leader.

- Bring customer stories to life: Find and develop the stories that demonstrate why customers are making the transition to post-quantum security and why they choose PQShield.

- Work across the company: Partner closely with product, engineering, sales, partnerships, and leadership to ensure the market sees one clear, compelling PQShield story.

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications 

We're looking for an experienced product marketing leader who is exceptionally strong in positioning, messaging and strategic storytelling. You can take an emerging market, complicated buyer problem or deeply technical product and find the clear narrative inside it.

A confirmed mobile engineer (8+ years) with exceptional craft and a real sensibility for design. You live in Expo and React Native, you care deeply about how the product feels , and you don’t wait for designs to be ready to propose something delightful. You have also experience building native experience. You think in interactions, motion, and detail.

You’ll own what members touch every day: onboarding, the core app surfaces, the moments that turn a first-time visitor into someone who trusts us with their health. Your work has to be delightful and reliable on real devices, for people who decide in minutes whether to trust us.

About you 

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

- You've shipped at least one product from 0→1 and felt the difference between writing code and building a system

- You have 2 deep areas of expertise and can operate across the full stack when the situation demands it

- You write specs before you write code — precise enough that an AI agent executes correctly on the first pass

- You review AI-generated code with the same rigor you'd apply to a junior engineer's PR: edge cases, security gaps, design smell

- You bias toward shipping. A good decision today beats a perfect one next week

- You're genuinely interested in health — maybe you track your own biomarkers, or you're just frustrated that healthcare is still reactive

We would not be a fit if 

- You need a clearly scoped role before you can operate

- You've only worked in large orgs with dedicated infra, QA, and platform teams

TypeScript monorepo · React Native · NestJS · PostgreSQL + Prisma · AWS (Terraform, Qovery) · GitHub Actions · Claude Code + Cursor

- Technical interview (30 min)

- At-home case study: hands-on project, delivery in 2 days.

- Deep dive (90 min) and team chat (on-site)

- Reference calls

- Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

- Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

- Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

At Lucis, AI isn't just our product, it's our engine. 100% of our teams are equipped with the best AI agents. You have carte blanche to explore and automate everything that can be, so you can focus exclusively on high-value work.

title: Full time paid Internship DSU/ Stage DSU Paris
description:
Introduction The selected person will join the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work across different country offices. Our growing team brings together diverse academic backgrounds and a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking.
The DSU contributes to policy consulting projects and conducts R&D to develop and test new applications, sometimes in collaboration with internal and external partners. Its work includes record linkage, classification, natural language processing, web scraping, generative AI and dynamic visualisations.
As an intern, you will work alongside experienced data scientists and policy consultants, applying and developing your technical skills to address real-world policy questions.

About this job The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations , sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. Our clients include French regional councils, the French Development Agency (AFD), ADEME, the European Commission and multilateral development banks.
You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals.
No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered.
We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026 . Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné).

Your profile We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy.
Suitable candidates should have:
- Master’s-level studies in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, engineering or another relevant discipline with a strong quantitative component, and be eligible for a university-sponsored internship.
- Practical programming skills in Python, demonstrated through coursework, research or personal projects, and the ability to write and understand their own analytical code.
- Good foundations in statistics and quantitative analysis, together with an interest in economics and public policy and in interpreting analytical results in their policy context.
- Basic familiarity with machine learning or natural language processing, and an interest in using generative AI and large language models programmatically through APIs for data processing, text analysis and knowledge extraction.
- A careful and structured approach to working with data, including attention to data quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility.
- An interest in public policy and in using data science to support evidence-based policymaking , particularly in areas such as science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition or health policy.
- Fluency in French and English, good communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively in an international and multicultural environment. A third language would be an asset.

Your responsibilities Working under the guidance of experienced colleagues, you will:
- Support the design and implementation of data science analyses to answer policy questions, writing code in Python.
- Collect, clean, link and validate data from multiple sources, including open datasets, databases and web-based sources.
- Help develop and test analytical workflows, potentially involving machine learning, NLP and LLM APIs for classification, text analysis and knowledge extraction.
- Contribute to indicators, scoreboards and visualisations, including dashboards where relevant, to make findings accessible to different audiences.
- Interpret and communicate results, helping prepare reports, methodological documentation and presentations for clients.
- Contribute to the DSU’s R&D and proposal preparation, for example by exploring new datasets, testing methods or developing small prototypes.

Our offer We offer a paid internship in Paris, with hands-on experience at the intersection of data science and public policy. You will work with an international, multidisciplinary team, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and contribute to both client projects and the development of new analytical applications.
Many of our interns become full-time staff at Technopolis or go on to pursue opportunities in the public and private sectors.

title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
description:
Contexte : 

Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.

L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).

Présentation d’Artefact : 

Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.

Sujet : 

Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.

Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.

Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.

Pré-requis 

Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :
BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur
Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études
Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027
Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Références 

- Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., & Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision , 64 (6), 672-689.

- Buolamwini, J., & Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency (pp. 77-91). PMLR.

- Cho, J., Zala, A., & Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.

- Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., & Liu, X. (2023). Dark-skin individuals are at more risk on the street: Unmasking fairness issues of autonomous driving systems. CoRR abs/2308.02935 .

- Thong, W., Joniak, P., & Xiang, A. (2023, October). Beyond skin tone: A multidimensional measure of apparent skin color. In 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) (pp. 4880-4890). IEEE.

- Shilova, V., Malherbe, E., Palma, G., Risser, L., & Loubes, J. M. (2025). Fairness-aware grouping for continuous sensitive variables: Application for debiasing face analysis with respect to skin tone. In ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy-Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025) Proceedings (pp. 5344-5351).

- Mary, J., Calauzenes, C., & El Karoui, N. (2019, May). Fairness-aware learning for continuous attributes and treatments. In International conference on machine learning (pp. 4382-4391). PMLR.

- Giuliani, L., Misino, E., & Lombardi, M. (2023, July). Generalized disparate impact for configurable fairness solutions in ML. In International Conference on Machine Learning (pp. 11443-11458). PMLR.

title: Technicien Maintenance & Métrologie
description:
A propos du poste : 

Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences.

Dans le cadre d’une mission au sein d’un environnement industriel pharmaceutique et dermo-cosmétique , nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Métrologie & Conformité. 

Intégré(e) au service Utilités & Métrologie , vous contribuez au suivi et à la fiabilité du parc d’appareillage scientifique du site. Votre rôle est de garantir la conformité, la fiabilité et la sécurité des équipements , tout en assurant le suivi des interventions de métrologie et de maintenance.

Missions Principales : 

- Assurer la gestion, le suivi et la mise à jour du parc d’équipements et d’appareils de mesure ;
- Planifier et réaliser les contrôles et vérifications métrologiques périodiques des équipements ;
- Participer au suivi et à la vérification des installations liées au traitement d’air, CVC et HVAC ;
- Réaliser ou coordonner les opérations de maintenance et de métrologie, en collaboration avec les utilisateurs et les prestataires externes ;
- Analyser les pannes, dysfonctionnements et non-conformités, assurer leur suivi et contribuer à la mise en œuvre des actions correctives ;
- Analyser les rapports de contrôle et vérifier la conformité des prestations réalisées ;
- Réaliser des essais techniques et comparatifs afin de développer ou d’améliorer les méthodes de contrôle métrologique ;
- Rédiger, mettre à jour et déployer les procédures métrologiques et organisationnelles ;
- Assurer la traçabilité des interventions ainsi que la mise à jour des informations relatives aux équipements dans les outils de gestion dédiés ;
- Collaborer avec les différents services afin d’analyser les prestations réalisées, d’identifier les nouveaux besoins et de garantir le maintien en conformité du parc
Requirements 

À propos de vous 

Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant. 

- Expérience : Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience sur des activités de métrologie, maintenance, instrumentation ou suivi d’équipements, idéalement dans un environnement industriel réglementé.
- Compétences techniques : Vous maîtrisez les activités de métrologie et de vérification périodique, ainsi que le suivi d’un parc d’équipements. Des connaissances en traitement d’air / CVC / HVAC, maintenance et analyse de pannes sont appréciées.
- Qualité et conformité : Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’identification et le traitement des non-conformités, l’analyse de rapports de contrôle et la gestion documentaire associée.
- Outils : Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel. La connaissance d’un logiciel de gestion de la métrologie, notamment Optimu, constitue un plus.
- Référentiels : La connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et ISO 10012, ainsi que des exigences réglementaires liées à la métrologie, est appréciée.
- Formation : Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation technique Bac+2 à Bac+3 en métrologie, mesures physiques, instrumentation, maintenance industrielle ou domaine équivalent.
- Qualités personnelles : Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre sens de l’organisation. Votre esprit d’analyse, vos qualités relationnelles et rédactionnelles et votre capacité à travailler avec différents interlocuteurs seront essentiels pour réussir dans cette mission.
- Permis B requis.
Benefits 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? 

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. 

Ce qui nous distingue :

Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur . 

Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient.

Exceller avec bienveillance 

Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune. 

Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya.

Rejoignez-nous aujourd’hui et devenez un Excelyate !

title: Senior Clinical Project Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Clinical Project Manager to oversee and coordinate clinical activities in pharmaceutical environment.
The role involves managing operational aspects of clinical trials, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, and acting as the primary interface between local stakeholders, investigators, vendors, and global teams.

This position requires strong autonomy, rigor, and excellent communication skills , with the ability to navigate cross‑functional environments.

Key Responsibilities : 

1. Study Management 

- Lead and coordinate clinical trial activities at the local level from start‑up to close‑out.
- Ensure local execution of global study plans in alignment with timelines and quality standards.
- Serve as the key point of contact for local investigational sites and regional stakeholders.

2. Regulatory & Compliance Oversight 

- Ensure that clinical trial activities comply with local regulations, ICH‑GCP, and internal SOPs.
- Coordinate local submissions to competent authorities and ethics committees when required.
- Monitor adherence to regulatory timelines and manage any corrective actions.

3. Site & Vendor Coordination 

- Support site selection, activation, monitoring, and close‑out in collaboration with CRAs and vendors.
- Manage relationships with local vendors (logistics, labs, CRO partners).
- Follow up on recruitment progress, performance, and site‑level metrics.

4. Cross‑Functional Collaboration 

- Work closely with global study teams, medical affairs, regulatory affairs, and clinical operations.
- Participate in study meetings and provide updates on local activities, challenges, and achievements.
- Support risk mitigation plans and operational troubleshooting.

5. Data Quality & Operational Tracking 

- Oversee data accuracy, query resolution, and compliance of documentation.
- Track KPIs, patient recruitment, timelines, and operational deliverables.
- Contribute to audit and inspection readiness.

Requirements 

- Experienced in Clinical Operations within pharma or CRO. 
- Experience as Clinical Project Manager, Study Manager, or equivalent .
- Previous involvement in interventional trials (Phase II–IV preferred).
- Solid understanding of ICH‑GCP, regulatory environment, and local clinical research practices.
- Experience collaborating with investigators, CROs, and cross‑functional teammates.
- Strong organizational, operational, and communication skills.
- Ability to manage several tasks simultaneously in a fast‑paced environment.
- Fluency in French and English (written & spoken).
Benefits 

Why join us?

At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with the enthusiasm of teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare.

Here's what makes us unique:

We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, driven by the goal of becoming the leading mid-sized CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience.

Our "one-stop provider" service model—combining full-service, functional service provider, and consulting—allows you to grow through diverse and stimulating projects.
