Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l’opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l’aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d’opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d’une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

- 
Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

- 
Cibler les entreprises locales générant d’importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

- 
Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

- 
Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

- 
Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

- 
Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

- 
Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

- 
Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

- 
Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

- 
Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

- 
Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

- 
Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

- 
Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux clients et d’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

- 
La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

- 
Un bon sens de l’organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

- 
La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d’expérience et à persévérer.

- 
Une bonne compréhension du statut d’indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

- 
La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

- 
Un réseau existant de chefs d’entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

- 
Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Agentic Product Manager
description:
About us: 

Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.

Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.

Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.

At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. 

About the role: 

We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.

This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.

We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm . 

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

- Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

- Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

- Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence

- Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership

- Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks

- Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

- Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

- Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

- Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

- Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area

You're a great fit if you: 

- Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products

- Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

- Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

- Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

- Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast

- Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value

- Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways — you seek input but aren’t afraid to take a stand

- Don’t just follow frameworks or "best practices" — you know when to break them

- Are energized by having a lot of ownership and working closely with smart, mission-driven teammates

- Are able to work on-site from our Zurich office

- Bonus: You have legal domain familiarity, or experience in search and knowledge management, agentic search and data retrieval, or LegalTech – or you’ve worked in/with law firms, legal departments, or regulated industries

What you can look forward to: 

- A high-impact role in shaping a product and company with huge potential

- The chance to work on the cutting edge of long-horizon agentic AI, applied to real-world legal work

- A strong, technical, and collaborative team that’s serious about building great software

- A culture that encourages experimentation, curiosity, and thoughtful decision-making

Submit your application by October 16th. Our team will review all candidates after the closing date and reach out regarding next steps.

At DeepJudge, we believe great teams are built on diverse perspectives and experiences. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If this role excites you, but you feel you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway and tell us why you’d be a great fit.

title: Head of Crypto
description:
About us 

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance .

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing 

As the Head of Crypto, you will be the driving force behind a brand new, core pillar of Satispay's expansion into the cryptocurrency and Web3 space. We already have a high-potential strategy in place—your mission is to take the reins, execute it flawlessly, adapt it when necessary, and expand upon it wherever possible.

Given the strategic importance of this initiative to Satispay, you will work with a high degree of autonomy and have direct, frequent touchpoints with the Satispay founding team to align on execution, team scaling, and long-term vision.

Here’s what that looks like in practice:

- Hire & Build Your Team: Identify talent needs, recruit, and structure a dedicated, high-performing cross-functional team from the ground up to bring Satispay's crypto vertical to life.

- Execution & Strategic Evolution: Take ownership of our existing crypto roadmap. Drive its execution to deliver immediate impact, while continuously evaluating the market to make necessary adjustments and expand our offerings when new opportunities arise.

- Executive Collaboration: Partner directly with the founders and C-level executives to ensure the crypto rollout continuously aligns with the company's ultimate mission to simplify everyday finance.

- Product Development: Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of our crypto products—from infrastructure setup and go-to-market strategy to launch and continuous optimization.

- Regulatory Navigation: Work in lockstep with the Compliance and Legal teams to ensure all products align perfectly with evolving European regulations (such as MiCA) and safeguarding standards.

- Strategic Partnerships: Identify and establish crucial relationships with key players in the crypto ecosystem, including exchanges, custodians, liquidity providers, and blockchain networks.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

What we're looking for 

We are seeking for an execution-focused, and product-minded leader with a deep passion for digital assets that matches our company culture.

- Experience: 7+ years of experience in crypto/Web3 initiatives at a regulated Fintech, exchange, or crypto-native company.

- Team Building: experience hiring, managing, and scaling specialized, high-performing teams in a fast-paced tech or financial environment.

- Master of Execution: ability to take a high-level strategy and turn it into shipped products, scaling operations effectively from the ground up.

- Industry & Market Expertise: Deep, technical understanding of blockchain architecture, crypto market dynamics, digital wallets, custody solutions, and Web3 infrastructure.

- Regulatory Awareness: Solid knowledge of the European crypto regulatory landscape (e.g., MiCA, AML/KYC for digital assets) and a history of launching products within a strict compliance framework.

- Strategic Adaptability: Ability to balance bold expansion with stringent risk management

- Communication & Influence: Excellent ability to align internal and external stakeholders, translating complex crypto concepts into clear, actionable business updates for the founding team.

- Language Proficiency: You are completely fluent in English. Knowledge of Italian is considered a plus.

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place 

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impacts are met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

- Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.

- Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding.

- Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

- Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact 

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. 

That’s why we created CareAbout:

- ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

- 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

- ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

- 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy, flexible working hours.

- 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

Equal Opportunity Employer 

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. 

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
IN SHORT Are you a versatile problem-solver who wants to write software that impacts the physical world? As a Full Stack Software Engineer (100%) in Zurich, you will be at the core of our operations, building systems that touch everything from warehouse automation to customer-facing smart fridges. 

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES - Take ownership of warehouse and supplier web apps used daily for inbound processing, picking, labeling, and inventory.
- Develop and maintain our internal back-office tool, including the backend and GraphQL API that runs menus, deliveries, inventory, and customer sites.
- Manage the service connecting automated picking lanes to the rest of the system to ensure uninterrupted warehouse operations.
- Maintain and update the Point of Sale Android app running on hundreds of fridges, managing the release process for the entire fleet.
- Integrate and support payment systems (Card, TWINT), our ERP, and other partner integrations.
- Participate in the on-call rotation to debug live issues directly alongside the operations team.
- Visit the warehouse on-site to test changes and gather feedback from the people actually using the software.
- Translate vague problems from non-technical colleagues into shipped solutions without needing them broken down first.
- Own production deployments, managing logs, alerts, and careful rollouts with clear rollback plans.
- Break down larger features, review other engineers' pull requests, and proactively maintain system health through upgrades, testing, and cleanup.

YOUR PROFILE - Proven production experience in at least one typed backend language (such as C#, Java, Kotlin, Go, or TypeScript) and one modern frontend framework.
- Track record of successfully owning software in production, including on-call duties, debugging from logs, and resolving live issues while users wait.
- Familiarity with or willingness to dive into C#, TypeScript, Android, and Kotlin.
- Prior exposure to hardware, IoT, edge devices, payments, logistics, retail operations, or Odoo environments is highly advantageous.
- Demonstrated ability to dive into unfamiliar tech stacks, learn quickly, and ship reliable code.
- Strong passion for collaborating directly with end-users, including warehouse and operations staff, rather than exclusively with other engineers.
- High degree of curiosity and a proactive mindset to take full ownership of problems from end to end.
- Fluent English communication skills (written and spoken); knowledge of German or French is a plus.
- Non-smoker - we don't want you to smell like cigarettes, neither at work nor at customer meetings. After all, FELFEL is about good food.
- Valid work permit or Swiss passport.

OUR BENEFITS - Lots of delicious food, just a few steps away from your desk - we make your gastronomic dreams come true
- Best barista coffee and tea for the whole team, thanks to our innovative Gavetti coffee machine
- 5 weeks holiday per year, as well as the chance to buy an extra week of vacation 
- Two full weeks of ‘work from anywhere’ per year to bring more variety to your work day
- We care about your future with an above-mandatory pension fund
- New parents get 16 or 3 weeks, respectively, of fully paid parental leave. We also support the return to work by making a generous financial contribution to childcare until the child reaches kindergarten age.
- We encourage our employees to use public transport by covering your half-fare travelcard
- Great team events, such as our well-known FELFEL Summer Outing

title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy, Intern
description:

Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role 

As a Software Engineer intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll work on the software that runs on our legged security robots: how they perceive their surroundings, know where they are, and move through real customer sites on patrol. You'll join the team that owns everything on the robot and take a well-scoped problem from first experiment to a result that runs on hardware.

The role focuses on building software for the robot autonomy stack that runs in the field. We'll agree your focus area with you during the interview process, based on your strengths and the team's priorities, and we expect you to own it from day one.

This role is hands-on. You'll work with real sensor data and field logs, test on physical robots, and see first-hand why a robot that works in the lab can still fail on a live site at night, in rain, or after the layout changes.

What You'll Work On 

- Build and improve components of the on-robot autonomy stack, such as perception, localisation and state estimation, or planning and navigation, depending on your background and the team's priorities.

- Integrate sensors such as lidar, cameras and IMU, and work with the data they produce in day, night and challenging weather.

- Reproduce issues from field deployments using logs and simulation, find the root cause, and help fix it at the right layer.

- Design repeatable tests and clear metrics that show whether a change holds up across routes, lighting, weather and site layouts.

- Test your work on physical robots, and join site visits to see how the system behaves in real operating conditions.

- Apply solid engineering practices: code review, version control, reproducible experiments and clear documentation.

Who We're Looking For 

We're looking for a strong robotics student who wants to see their work run on real robots, not only in simulation. You don't need every item below, but you should meet the core requirements and bring depth in at least one area of the autonomy stack. You'll join a small team that moves fast, expects ownership, and holds work to the standard of running on live customer sites.

Your Background 

- Currently pursuing a Master's or PhD, or completed a Master's degree within the last year, in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a closely related field.

- Demonstrated depth in at least one of perception, localisation and state estimation, or motion planning and navigation, through a thesis, research or a substantial project.

- Strong coding skills in Python.

- Hands-on experience with ROS 2.

- Comfortable using Linux, Docker and Git in your workflows.

Nice to Have 

- Experience working with physical robots, ideally mobile or legged.

- Experience with lidar or camera processing, SLAM, or sensor fusion.

- Experience with robotics simulators such as Isaac Sim, Gazebo or MuJoCo.

- Publications or competition results in robotics (ICRA, IROS, RSS, CoRL).

What We Offer

- Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

- Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

- Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

description:
About HappyRobot 

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. experiment and iterate.

cause of issues.

Must Have 

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

tight deadlines.

propose solutions.

- Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
action.

- Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us? 

- Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

- Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

- Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

- Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

- Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles 

Extreme Ownership 

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship 

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

In healthcare, the phone is still the front door, and call volume keeps rising while the people answering it are harder to hire and keep. title: Head of Hardware
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI. 

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Head of Hardware, you own that hardware end to end: electrical, firmware, and the mechanical integration that holds it together, from the first schematic to devices running on factory floors.

You lead the team that builds it. Today that is about six engineers on robotics, three on EMG sensing, and three on camera systems, plus contractors, and it will grow quickly. Our Electrical Engineer and Embedded Engineer roles report to you. You set the architecture they build against, and you still build alongside them.

This is a founder-shaped role, not a management seat. We are looking for someone who has carried a product from a blank page to customers with real skin in the game, wants to build both the thing and the team that builds it, and would rather design than review. If that sounds like you, you will want to do it again at the earliest stage.

What You Will Do

- Own the hardware roadmap for Shift and Atlas data capture: wearables, sensor rigs, camera systems, and prototype robots. What we build, in what order, and why.

- Set the system architecture across electrical, firmware, and mechanical: sensors, compute, power, wireless, and enclosures. Make the trade-offs, and make them stick when disciplines disagree.

- Stay on the bench: schematics, layout reviews, board bring-up, and a scope in your hands when the team is stuck. On the days it matters, you are the best electrical engineer in the room.

- Lead and grow the team: hire, set the bar, run design reviews, and give engineers ownership of whole subsystems rather than tickets.

- Guarantee data quality end to end: EMG and EEG front ends, camera pipelines, IMUs, and synchronization across many devices, so that what reaches the ML team is clean, time-aligned, and trustworthy.

- Take designs from prototype to small-batch production: DFM, component and EMS vendors, test fixtures, certification, and field reliability.

- Work shoulder to shoulder with ML and deployment. Your hardware decides what the training data looks like, and you will be on the floor where it is captured.

- Run contractors and partners without losing ownership of the result.

Requirements

- You have taken at least one product from zero to shipped, with significant ownership of the outcome: as a co-founder, CTO, first hardware hire, or the lead who owned the whole device. Not one subsystem, not one phase. Ideally a wearable, at a tier-one hardware company known for shipping at scale.

- Electrical engineering is your home discipline. You have designed boards that shipped, across mixed-signal, power, wireless, and high-speed digital, and you can still do it today.

- You think in systems. You understand how an electrode choice, an enclosure tolerance, and an ADC sample rate interact, and you can hold the mechanical and firmware conversations as a peer, not a customer.

- You have led engineers: hired them, grown them, and kept a team shipping through 0-to-1 ambiguity. Typically 6+ years in hardware, but we care more about what you shipped than how long it took.

- A strong understanding of how hardware decisions affect data quality. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you design accordingly.

- Experience taking hardware to small-batch production: DFM, vendor and EMS management, test, and certification.

- Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

- High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. A 0-to-1 hardware program takes the hours it takes, in person and at pace, and you have chosen that before.

- Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

Nice to Have

- Wearables, smartwatches, drones, robotics, AR/VR, or defense wearables on your résumé.

- Camera systems: sensor selection, MIPI and ISP pipelines, and multi-camera synchronization.

- Low-power and battery design, BLE or Wi-Fi, and antenna integration in small enclosures.

- Enough mechanical fluency (CAD, tolerances, and materials) to challenge the mechanical team’s choices and be right some of the time.

- Prior founder or founding-engineer experience, including the parts that went wrong.

- Open-source hardware or firmware contributions.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

- Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

- Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

- Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

- Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if: 

- You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

- You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

- You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if: 

- You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

- You would forward output you cannot explain.

- "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

- Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

- Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

- Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

- Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

- Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

- Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

- Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

- A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

- Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.

title: Founder Associate to the CTO
description:
The Role 
As Founders Associate in our office in Zurich, you'll be the right hand of our CTO, Max. You run the daily business of the CTO office, own strategic projects from start to finish, drive the first round of our technical hiring, and bridge technology and business. This is a true zero-to-one mandate.
Whether you come from computer science or business, you combine strong tech understanding with real commercial thinking. You won't be writing production code, but you'll understand our product and infrastructure well, be a trusted counterpart for our engineers, and know what technical decisions mean for the business.

What You'll Do 

- CTO Office & Executive Support 

- Manage our CTO's priorities so his time goes to what matters most

- Prepare briefing documents and agendas for important meetings and make sure every action item gets followed up

- Technical Hiring 

- Run first-round calls with engineering candidates and coordinate the interview process with our team

- Strategic Projects 

- Take full ownership of critical projects, from deep dives into emerging tech trends to board-level material

- Evaluate and drive strategic technical partnerships that keep us at the forefront of AI infrastructure

- Tech x Business 

- Translate technical topics into commercial decisions and clear stories for customers, partners and investors

- Support pricing, product and go-to-market questions with a technical angle

- Build the processes the CTO office and engineering team need to scale

What We're Looking For 

- Studies (preferably Master level) or a degree in computer science or a related technical field, OR in business, economics or management with a strong understanding of technology

- Very good commercial understanding: you think in business impact, not just technology

- Real curiosity for tech: you can follow and discuss AI and infrastructure topics with engineers

- First practical experience in a fast-paced environment such as a startup, consulting or VC

- Builder's mindset: you take high ownership and enjoy building processes from scratch

- Hustle & execution: you're pragmatic and move fast without losing sight of quality – a "get shit done" mentality is essential

- Organizational talent: you stay calm under pressure and work in a highly structured and precise way

- Communication: excellent written and verbal English, German is a plus

Bonus Points 

- Exposure to AI, cloud or GPU infrastructure

- You've built something yourself: a side project, student initiative or venture

Why us? 

- Outstanding team: Work with some of the best engineers in the world, coming from hedge funds, big tech, AI startups and top universities

- Once in a lifetime opportunity: Early-stage company in the fastest-growing market in the world

- Ownership: Shape how European AI companies access GPU compute

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role 

As a Computer Vision Engineer in the Computer Vision Tracker team , you will join us at a very early stage, giving you a unique opportunity to heavily influence the technical direction of the team. Operating out of Lausanne, Paris, or Zurich, you will focus on creating a global 3D Object Tracking pipeline, at the intersection between the Computer Vision, Sensor Fusion and GNC teams.

Responsibilities 

- Computer Vision Algorithm Development: Research and implement state-of-the-art Computer Vision approaches to Object Tracking in multiple modalities and scenarios, combining classical and geometrical methods with AI detection models developed in-house.

- Multi-Sensor Fusion: Fuse data from multiple sensors (Cameras, IMU, Radar, etc.) to provide high-precision target estimation and robust tracking through challenging conditions.

- Edge Optimization for Low-Compute Deployment: Optimize and embed tracking algorithms on heterogeneous platforms with limited compute resources, ensuring real-time performance alongside other software bricks running on the drone.

- Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with the GNC, Sensor Fusion, and AI teams to integrate your tracking pipelines into a seamless, production-ready environment.

- R esearch & Innovation: Stay at the absolute forefront of scientific trends in computer vision, tracking algorithms, and sensor fusion to introduce cutting-edge methodologies to the product.

- Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by managing or mentoring junior engineers.

Candidate Requirements 

- Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in a STEM field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, Mathematics).

- Embedded Algorithmic Expertise: Proven track record in the research, development, and productization of Computer Vision & Sensor-Fusion algorithms in hardware-constrained environments.

- Technical Competence: Strong proficiency in C++ and Python for real-time systems. Experience with optimizing code for edge deployment.

Nice to have 

- Highly structured, analytical, task-aligned, and research-oriented.

- Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to effectively translate and present complex algorithmic trade-offs to downstream users and senior stakeholders.

- Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a “no-task-is-too-small” mentality toward building foundational team infrastructure.

- Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
This is Cradle

Proteins are the molecular machines of life, used for many therapeutic, diagnostic, chemical, agricultural and food applications. Designing and optimizing proteins takes a lot of expert knowledge and manual effort, through the use of custom computational and biological tools. 

Machine learning is revolutionizing this space, by enabling high-fidelity protein models. At Cradle, we offer a software platform for AI-guided discovery and optimization of proteins, so that biologists can design proteins faster and at scale. We are already used by clients across biopharma, biotech, agri-tech, food-tech, and academia.

We're an experienced team of just under 100 people. We've built many successful products before and have enough funding for multiple years of runway. We are distributed across three offices in Amsterdam, Boston, and Zurich, alongside a few remote colleagues.

We offer our employees a very competitive salary, a generous equity stake in the company and a wide range of benefits and career progression opportunities.

The Role 

As Executive Assistant at Cradle, you'll keep two of our founding executives moving. Between customer visits, investor meetings, hiring and travel across Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, there's a lot to keep track of, and your job is to make sure nothing gets dropped. You'll own their calendars, inboxes and travel, and take care of the personal admin that would otherwise eat into their time. This role suits someone who likes being trusted with the whole picture, professional and personal, and treats both with the same care.

Responsibilities 

- Run two calendars as one system: Protect focus time, balance competing priorities across time zones, and decide what deserves a meeting and what can be an email.

- Own the inbox front line: Triage, draft and reply on their behalf to customers, investors, candidates and the team, so the important things surface and the rest gets handled.

- Plan travel end to end: Customer visits, conferences and trips between Amsterdam, Zurich and the US, from flights and hotels to the meeting room and dinner booking on the other side.

- Take care of personal and life admin: Appointments, household logistics, official paperwork, bills and renewals, handled so none of it lands on their desks.

- Prepare every important meeting: Make sure briefs and context are ready beforehand, and follow up on decisions and action items afterwards.

- Make recurring admin disappear: Automate repeated processes so they mostly run themselves.

Requirements 

The best people we've hired didn't match a checklist. Below is a list of what matters most for this role. If you bring most of it and are curious about the rest, we'd love to hear from you: 

- 4+ years supporting senior executives, ideally more than one at a time

- Sharp judgment about what's urgent, what can wait and what never needs to reach the exec

- Clear, polished written English

- You spot the next problem before anyone asks and fix it

- Experience handling personal admin alongside the professional side, with the discretion that comes with it

- Organised and dependable without needing a rigid structure; at a ~90-person company you'll often build the process yourself

- At home in Google Workspace and quick to pick up new software tools

Nice to Haves 

These aren't requirements, but they'd give you a head start:

- German fluency would be idea to would make local appointments, paperwork and authorities much easier

- Experience in a startup or scale-up environment

- Familiarity with Swiss administrative procedures (permits, insurance, tax paperwork, relocations)

- Experience with task tools like Todoist, Notion or Linear

Our commitment to inclusive hiring

Cradle evaluates all candidates based on merit, regardless of sex, gender, ethnicity, socio-economic background, or any other aspect of identity. We maintain zero tolerance for discrimination and actively encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

AI disclosure

Cradle uses an applicant tracking system that includes basic AI-assisted features which may generate scores or rankings based on how applications match a job description. These outputs are not used to make or meaningfully influence hiring decisions — all candidates are evaluated through a thorough, human-led review by our recruiting team.

A notice about recruitment scams 

Please be aware that scammers are posing as us in order to get your personal details or money. We only communicate via @ cradle.bio email addresses, we only make job offers after having met you in person at our office in Zurich or Amsterdam, and we never ask you to pay for anything during the interview process.

title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a skilled Senior Software Engineer to join our high-impact team Orion – Supply Division and help us shape the future of mobility operations. Our team owns a critical product at the heart of the Flix ecosystem — optimizing how Flix coordinates with Mobility Partners to keep millions of passengers moving across the globe. 

We maintain and continuously evolve a mature, stable product while simultaneously pushing it forward — tackling complex architectural challenges, reducing manual processes, and exploring AI-driven solutions. You'll take real ownership, contributing not just to code, but to product and technical decisions that directly impact the business. 

If you enjoy working in a collaborative, self-organized team where engineers have a genuine voice, and you're excited about solving complex problems at scale — this might be the right next step for you. 

Our tech stack: 

Backend development: Java, Spring / Spring Boot, Kafka 
Databases: MongoDB (DocumentDB), MySQL / Postgres (RDS), Redis (Elasticache) 
Cloud services: AWS, S3 
DevOps / Infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker, Gitlab CI, Terraform 
Additional tools and technologies: Microservices architecture, Event-driven systems, Distributed systems design and implementation 

About the Role 

- You'll collaborate with a distributed, self-organized, cross-functional team, taking full ownership of the development process and technical decisions 

- You'll have the opportunity to design new products from the ground up while continuously improving existing ones, with room to explore and implement cutting-edge technologies 

- Drive the development process in an Agile environment, placing our users at the center of each solution you and your team create 

- Lead technical decisions not just within your team, but across teams, improving technical excellence through collaboration and lateral leadership 

- Help define and deliver products that optimize the coordination between Flix and Mobility Partners, enhancing efficiency and reducing manual tasks 

- Be part of a team building a critical product within the Flix ecosystem—solving complex challenges due to product's diverse user base and Flix's global presence 

About You 

- 6+ years of experience as a Software Java and/or Kotlin Engineer, with knowledge of distributed systems, including Spring/Spring Boot, Kafka, MySQL/Postgres, Redis, MongoDB and S3 

- Willingness to work with both Java (for existing products) and Kotlin (for new ones) 

- Experience in making architectural decisions, and writing clean, performant, well-tested code 

- Autonomy and ownership in solving technical challenges, as well as strong communication skills when working with a distributed team 

- A strong product mindset, with a passion for user experience and a data-driven approach to decision-making 

- Experience in coding with AI 

- Fluent in English (upper-intermediate or higher) 

Nice-to-haves: 

- Experience with DevOps and infrastructure: Kubernetes, Docker, Gitlab CI, AWS, Terraform 

- Familiarity with data engineering (ETL, Snowflake) 

- Ability to teach people, share knowledge and experience, explain complex things in plain language, mentor, and provide constructive feedback 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer 

- Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

- Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 

- Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 

- Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

- Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

- Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career 

Why join Flix? 

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

title: Senior Sales Manager, Regional Enterprise
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich . 

What you'll be doing 

In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

- Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.

- Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.

- Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.

- Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.

- Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.

- Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.

- Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.

- Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.

- Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations 

- You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.

- You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.

- You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.

- You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.

- You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.

- You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.

- You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.

- You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. 

What we offer 

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps 

If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich . 

What you'll be doing 

In this role, you'll own the acquisition and development of high-value regional Enterprise retail partners in Germany, from identifying and engaging the right prospects through commercial negotiations, signing and initial rollout. You'll combine strong commercial execution with a strategic view on which partners can have the greatest impact on Wolt's selection, coverage and long-term growth.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

- Own the end-to-end sales cycle for regional Enterprise retail opportunities, from prospecting and qualification through negotiation, contracting and signing.

- Build and manage a high-quality pipeline of larger regional retailers and multi-location partners across priority verticals such as grocery, convenience, pet, pharmacy and beauty.

- Develop a deep understanding of prospective partners' businesses and create compelling commercial propositions that demonstrate the value of partnering with Wolt.

- Lead complex commercial negotiations, balancing partner needs with sustainable economics and Wolt's long-term business objectives.

- Build strong relationships with senior decision-makers and act as a trusted commercial partner throughout the sales process.

- Work closely with internal teams including Operations, Account Management, Finance, Legal, Marketing and Product to structure partnerships and enable successful launches.

- Take ownership beyond the signature, ensuring a strong handover and initial rollout so that newly acquired partners can successfully go live and scale.

- Use market insights, pipeline data and commercial learnings to identify opportunities, prioritize the highest-impact accounts and continuously improve our regional Enterprise sales approach.

- Contribute to sharing best practices and raising the bar for Enterprise sales execution across the wider team.

Our humble expectations 

- You have significant experience in B2B sales, business development or strategic partnerships, ideally working with Enterprise or other complex, multi-stakeholder customers.

- You have a strong track record of independently managing and closing complex commercial opportunities from initial outreach through contract signature.

- You're an excellent negotiator and understand how to build partnerships that create sustainable value for both sides.

- You're comfortable engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, both externally and across cross-functional internal teams.

- You combine a hands-on, results-oriented sales mindset with strong commercial judgment and the ability to prioritize opportunities based on their strategic impact.

- You're highly structured and comfortable managing multiple opportunities and stakeholders simultaneously while maintaining strong attention to detail.

- You're comfortable working with data and commercial metrics to evaluate opportunities, build business cases and inform decisions.

- You communicate clearly and persuasively and are fluent in German and English. 

What we offer 

This is an opportunity to play a meaningful role in the next phase of Wolt's Retail growth. You'll have direct ownership of high-impact regional partnerships and the autonomy to take opportunities from first conversation all the way through to launch.

You'll work at the intersection of sales, strategy and operations, collaborating with experienced colleagues across Wolt while building relationships with some of the most important retailers in the market. The role offers substantial commercial ownership and exposure while giving you the opportunity to develop further in Enterprise sales and contribute to how we scale our Retail business.

You'll also join a fast-moving international environment where good ideas can quickly turn into action, with the tools, support and trust to take ownership of your work and make a visible impact.

Next steps 

If this sounds like an opportunity you'd be excited about, we'd love to hear from you.

After you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application and get in touch with selected candidates for an initial conversation. The process will typically include interviews with the hiring team and relevant stakeholders, giving you the opportunity to learn more about the role, team and business while we get to know your experience and approach.

Depending on the role and location, the process may also include a practical case or commercial exercise. We'll share the exact interview steps and expectations with you as you progress through the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior/ Expert Relationship Manager (w/m/d)

GROPYUS is a technology-based construction company focused on building multi-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with a wide range of design options, automated offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company is able to create resilient timber housing quickly and cost-effectively. The company delivers its multi-family houses as a complete and turnkey solution. The combination of technology, construction, robotics, and manufacturing expertise means buildings can be created in a fully digitalized end-to-end process. - Strukturierte, proaktive Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, auch in komplexen Projektsituationen Klarheit und Orientierung zu schaffen

title: (Senior) Product Manager, Trust Platform- Digital Identities (f/m/d) - 1 year fixed contract
description:
IDnow is a leader in digital identity and fraud prevention in Europe with a mission to transform trust into the most powerful asset in the digital world, empowering enterprises with AI-driven, SaaS-based identity solutions that deliver scalable security, adaptive compliance, and real-time fraud prevention . Through its broad portfolio of digital identity and fraud prevention solutions, IDnow establishes, maintains and enriches trust throughout the customer journey, ensuring businesses can confidently and securely operate while leveraging digital identity to drive growth, security and scalability. 

The company has offices in Germany, United Kingdom, Romania and France , and is backed by renowned institutional investors, including Corsair Capital and Seventure Partners. Its portfolio of international clients spans a wide range of end markets including financial services, telecommunications, travel & mobility, gaming, and other industries. 

This position is based in Rennes/Paris, France OR in Berlin/Munich, Germany and a fixed term(full time) contract of 1 year as a maternity replacement. 

As ( Senior) Product Manager, Trust Platform – Digital Identities(f/m/d) , you own the product direction for how IDnow's Trust Platform supports European eID schemes and EUDI Wallets. You define the strategy for digital identity methods, act as the counterpart to IDnow's Trust Services team, and ensure the platform stays ahead of eIDAS 2.0 requirements as they become mandatory across the EU. This is a focused, partially technical role that requires depth over breadth: you go deep into the specifications of eID schemes and EUDI Wallets rather than staying at a surface level. 

Key Responsibilities 

You shape how IDnow's Trust Platform supports digital identities across Europe, ensuring customers can rely on compliant, seamless, and secure identification methods. 

- Strategic Portfolio: Define the digital identity strategy and portfolio of identification methods for EUDI Wallets and eIDs, evaluating and deciding between direct integrations and broker-based approaches. 

- Trust Services Counterpart: Act as the counterpart to IDnow's Trust Services team and ensure a smooth integration of electronic signatures, Qualified Electronic Attestations of Attributes (QEAAs), and related trust services into the Trust Platform. 

- Regulatory Leadership: Stay ahead of eIDAS 2.0 and EUDI Wallet standards, tracking evolving technical specifications and implementing acts to ensure the platform is compliant well before deadlines hit. 

- Identity Interoperability: Ensure seamless cross-border identity verification, managing the nuances of different EU member state requirements, national eID schemes, and trust frameworks. 

- Conversion Optimization: Analyze the friction-versus-security trade-off for each identification method and provide clear recommendations to help customers maximize their onboarding rates. 

- Own the end-to-end specification of eID and EUDI Wallet integrations, going into technical detail on protocols, data models, and trust frameworks. 

- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Legal, Compliance, and Solutions teams to translate regulatory requirements into concrete product and technical specifications. 

Turn back if…

• You are not comfortable diving into regulatory requirements in depth and becoming a subject matter expert on EUDI wallets and national eID schemes.
• You're most comfortable in a traditional product-owner role centred on backlog management and delivery, rather than shaping strategy and technical specifications..
• You want a fully structured environment where every process and specification is already documented — this role is about defining the direction while the standards themselves are still evolving..
• You're not willing to travel frequently to Rennes or work across multiple jurisdictions and member-state requirements..

Preferred Experience 

- Bring 5 + product management experience with end-to-end ownership of product strategy, discovery, prioritisation, delivery, and continuous improvement, ideally in a regulated or standards-driven environment. 

- Knowledge of eID schemes or EUDI Wallets is a strong plus – you are comfortable navigating technical specifications, protocols, and regulatory texts in depth, not just at a conceptual level. 

- Knowledge of Identity & Access Management and authentication protocols such as OIDC, SAML, and OAuth is a strong plus. 

- Demonstrate experience in digital identity, trust services, fraud prevention, compliance, or a regulated industry such as banking, fintech, insurance, or telecommunications. 

- Show a high level of autonomy and ownership: this is a focused scope that requires a strong, detail-oriented executor who can work independently while always keeping track of business metrics and customer feedback. 

- Communicate complex regulatory and technical topics clearly to engineering teams, senior stakeholders, customers, and internal enablement audiences. 

- Willingness to be based in or travel frequently to Rennes, France, to work closely with the local team. 

- Fluency in English and French is required; additional European languages are a plus given the cross-border, multi-jurisdictional nature of the role. 

Perks & Benefits 

- Health & Wellbeing: Use your full access to the mental health platform nilo, including 1on1 sessions. 

- We value personal and professional development: make full use of Udemy, our training platform with 24/7 access and unlimited licences. 

- We make your remote work comfy: we provide support on equipment and offer flexible working hours. 

- We value collaboration & love to come together: regular onsite gatherings, internal initiatives and summer parties to connect across teams. 

- May your family require your attention or other reasons apply: use the benefits of our parental leave policy or our sabbatical programme. 

- In addition to the perks & benefits above, we offer specific benefits that differ between our locations.

title: Senior Data Scientist/ML Engineer - Financial Crime
description:
Help build ML systems that make financial crime harder to hide 

Financial crime is constantly changing. New patterns and behaviours emerge all the time, and the data we work with is complex. Our work helps make financial activity safer and more trustworthy for merchants, customers, and SumUp.

As a Senior Data Science/ML Engineer in the Risk AI Engineering Squad, you will build the production systems that turn machine learning into reliable, explainable transaction-monitoring capabilities. You will work across the full model lifecycle: understanding financial-crime typologies, exploring data, engineering features, training and validating models, deploying them at scale, and monitoring their performance over time.

This role is designed for someone who is strongest on the engineering side of machine learning and wants to keep growing their data-science depth. You do not need to be a traditional data scientist or ML Engineer. We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across both disciplines: building robust, production-ready software while staying close to the data, models, and decisions those systems support.

You will join a cross-functional team within the Risk & Compliance tribe, working closely with AML and Fraud Operations, investigators, Product, and Engineering. Together, we build data products and ML solutions that help Risk teams work smarter, faster, and more effectively — while keeping our controls robust, auditable, and compliant across products and markets.

We actively welcome applications from women and people from underrepresented backgrounds. Diverse perspectives make our team stronger and our systems more robust. If you're motivated by technical depth, real-world impact, and the challenge of making ML work reliably in a high-stakes environment, this role is built for you.

What you’ll do 

Build ML systems that work in production 

- Own and evolve end-to-end batch training pipelines for transaction-monitoring models.

- Build reliable software around the model lifecycle, including testing, CI/CD, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and rollback.

- Improve the maintainability, observability, and scalability of our model pipelines.

- Partner with platform and software engineers to make model delivery repeatable and safe.

Turn data and domain knowledge into better detection 

- Build, maintain, and improve ML models for transaction monitoring, balancing detection quality, operational efficiency, explainability, and regulatory expectations.

- Engineer features that reflect AML and Fraud typologies and suspicious behaviours.

- Work with Risk investigators to translate domain knowledge into useful signals, alerting logic, and calibrated thresholds.

- Analyse the drivers of the AML Risk Score and recommend improvements to its features, logic, and thresholds.

Keep models trustworthy over time 

- Define and track meaningful model and operational metrics, including detection performance, alert volumes, and investigator outcomes.
