title: GenAI Engineer (F/H/NB)
description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway . Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network ), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés : 

- 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA. 

- 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique. 

- Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network. 

- 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... 

- +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute. 

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts ( Individual Contributor / IC ), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. 

▪️ À propos de la mission 

En tant qu'Expert & Trainer GenAI, tu t'inscris à la croisée de l'ingénierie logicielle, de la formation d'élite et du conseil stratégique. Tu es le garant de la mise en œuvre pragmatique et sécurisée de l'IA chez nos clients. 

Architecture & Ingénierie GenAI 

Tu concois, pilotes et déploies des architectures GenAI robustes et prêtes pour la production : 

- 
Model Engineering & Contexte : Arbitrage et choix des LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Open Source), optimisation des paramètres (fenêtre de contexte, context caching , system prompts ) et maîtrise du Model Context Protocol (MCP). 

- 
Pipelines Avancés & RAG : Conception de stratégies de retrieval complexes (chunking, bases vectorielles, GraphRAG, hybride) et orchestration de workflows agentiques (LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, patterns ReAct). 

- 
Industrialisation & FinOps : Évaluation de la fiabilité (LLM-as-a-judge), maîtrise des coûts au token, guardrails de sécurité (AI Act, prompt injection, étanchéité des données) et déploiement multi-cloud (Vertex AI, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI). 

Formation & Transmission "Développeur Augmenté" (SFEIR Institute) 

Tu es le visage de l'excellence pédagogique de SFEIR. Tu conçois et animes nos parcours phares (jusqu'à 60% de pratique / labs) pour transformer les méthodes de dev chez nos clients : 

- 
Agentic Coding : Acculturation aux workflows de développement assisté ( Specify → Plan → Tasks → Implement → Validate ) via des outils comme Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou Gemini CLI. 

- 
Standardisation d'équipe : Diffusion des bonnes pratiques de gestion de contexte ( CLAUDE.md , règles modulaires, génération de tests) et création de serveurs MCP sécurisés. 

- 
Pédagogie & Regard Critique : Vulgarisation adaptative (du décideur à l'ingénieur) tout en insufflant une culture de la sécurité (code review, vulnérabilités) et du maintien des compétences en dev classique. 

Conseil & Stratégie GenAI 

Tu transformes des besoins métiers complexes ou flous en feuilles de route opérationnelles et à fort ROI : 

- 
Cadrage & Roadmap : Animation d'ateliers d'idéation, priorisation des cas d'usage ( Quick Wins vs Chantiers structurants ) et construction du business case pour les sponsors. 

- 
Architecture de Solutions : Arbitrages Build vs Buy , conception de couches intermédiaires (Context Graphs) pour maîtriser la dette technique et l'économie du token. 

- 
Gouvernance & Change : Accompagnement des instances dirigeantes (COMEX, CODIR) sur la gestion du risque, la conformité et la conduite du changement. 

▪️ Le profil idéal 

Formation & Parcours : Titulaire d'un Bac+5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur ou Master universitaire) ou bénéficiant d'une solide expérience terrain équivalente dans la conception logicielle et l'architecture système. 

Expérience : Tu justifies d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience globale en ingénierie logicielle ou architecture cloud, avec une spécialisation marquée et récente en IA générative , ingénierie de prompt et orchestration agentique. Une première expérience réussie en formation/consulting ou une appétence forte pour la transmission est indispensable. 

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais 

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence. 

▪️ Tes conditions de travail 

- Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine. 

- Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération).

title: Développeur C# / .Net (F/H/NB)
description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway . Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network ), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés : 

- 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA 

- 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique 

- Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network 

- 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... 

- +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute 

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts ( Individual Contributor / IC ), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches à faible valeur ajoutée et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. 

▪️ À propos de la mission 

Pour accompagner la forte croissance de notre collectif Sud-Ouest, nous recherchons notre futur Développeur .Net/C# (F/H/NB). 

Tes missions au quotidien : 

- Back-end : Maîtrise avancée de C# / .NET 8+, architectures Microservices et APIs sécurisées 

- Data & Messaging : Gestion de la donnée sous toutes ses formes avec SQL Server, MongoDB et architectures orientées événements via Kafka 

- Cloud & Industrialisation : Déploiement sur environnements Cloud Public (Azure, AWS ou GCP) et conteneurisation (Docker/Kubernetes) 

- Craftsmanship : Le Clean Code, le TDD et les revues de code sont tes standards de livraison, pas des options 

▪️ Le profil idéal 

Formation & Parcours : Bac+5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur, Master) ou équivalent. 

Expérience : 5 ans minimum comme Développeur .NET (idéalement sur de forts volumes de données ), avec une maîtrise de : 

- 
.NET Core 8 , Microservices, DDD, REST & Design First . 

- 
Databases & Messaging : SQL Server, MongoDB, Kafka, RabbitMQ. 

- 
DevOps & Cloud : DevOps (CI/CD), Docker, Kubernetes, Grafana. 

- 
Outillage : Git, JIRA. 

Soft Skills : Esprit d'équipe, autonomie, rigueur, sens de l'initiative et curiosité technique. 

▪️ L'ancrage Bordelais 

L'agence SFEIR Bordeaux regroupe une quinzaine d'ingénieurs et d'architectes seniors. Tu y trouveras la proximité et l'agilité d'une structure à taille humaine, adossée à la solidité d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à l'écosystème tech local (meetups, conférences BDX/IO, SFEIR Talks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D de l'agence. 

▪️ Tes conditions de travail 

- Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine. 

- Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération). 

- Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant. 

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

- Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR. 

- Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo, C# et .Net) avec trois Sfeirians. 

- Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Bordeaux. 

- Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence. 

Prêt·e à passer au niveau supérieur sans renoncer à tes valeurs ? Postule et viens rencontrer le collectif !

title: Data Engineer (F/H/NB)
description:
SFEIR est un cabinet d'expertise technologique spécialisé dans la conception, l'architecture et l'industrialisation de solutions numériques sur-mesure. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs transformations les plus complexes en combinant la rigueur du Software Craftsmanship avec la maîtrise des technologies d'avenir. Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway . Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network ), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques. 

Nos chiffres clés : 

- 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA 

- 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique 

- Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network 

- 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Databricks, Confluent... 

- +5000 personnes formées par an via le SFEIR Institute 

Rejoindre SFEIR, c'est intégrer un collectif où la culture technique prévaut. Nous offrons des trajectoires de carrière dédiées aux experts ( Individual Contributor / IC ), te permettant de progresser en haute maîtrise technique sans devoir basculer vers du management organisationnel. Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches répétitives et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes. 

▪️ À propos de la mission 

Pour accompagner la forte croissance de notre collectif Sud-Ouest, nous recherchons notre futur Data Engineer confirmé (F/H/NB). Au cœur de nos projets clients les plus ambitieux, ton objectif principal sera de donner de la valeur à la donnée et d'imaginer des architectures de pointe, prêtes pour l'IA ( AI-Ready ) . 

Au quotidien, tu seras le moteur technique de la structuration des données chez nos clients : 

- Architecturer des pipelines data robustes avec Python, SQL, dbt et Airflow 

- Travailler avec BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Kafka ou les outils MLOps 

- Penser Data Quality, gouvernance, observabilité et optimisation des coûts 

- Construire des plateformes de données fiables et évolutives 

- Participer à l’industrialisation des usages IA 

- Transformer des datasets complexes en produits data exploitables 

- Expérimenter les nouveaux usages de l’IA appliqués à la Data 

▪️ Le profil idéal 

- Formation & Parcours : Titulaire d'un Bac+5 en informatique (Master, école d'ingénieur) ou un parcours équivalent avec une solide expérience acquise sur le terrain. 

- Expérience : Tu justifies de 4 à 5 ans d'expérience réussie sur un rôle similaire de Data Engineer, idealement dans des environnements exigeants. 

- Stack & Méthode : Tu maîtrises l'écosystème Cloud et Big Data, tu aimes appliquer les bonnes pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle (CI/CD, tests, code clean) et tu as envie de transmettre ton savoir-faire au sein du collectif. 

▪️ L'ancrage Toulousain 

L'agence SFEIR Toulouse regroupe une équipe à taille humaine de plus de 10 expert·e·s de haut niveau. Tu y bénéficies de la proximité et de l'agilité d'une structure locale, tout en adossant tes projets à la solidité financière et technique d'un grand groupe. Tu participes activement à la vie de la scène tech locale (DevFest Toulouse, SFEIR Talks, afterworks) et tu peux intégrer le programme AI Champions pour piloter la R&D et l'intégration des LLMs au niveau régional. 

▪️ Tes conditions de travail 

- Organisation : 2 à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine. 

- Équipement : Laptop haut de gamme au choix (MacBook Pro ou Dell Precision dernière génération). 

- Package : Rémunération fixe attractive, prime de vacances, accord d'intéressement, forfait mobilités durables, mutuelle et titres-restaurant. 

▪️ Le processus de recrutement 

- Échange RH : Alignement sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les opportunités SFEIR. 

- Session Technique ("PlayOffs") : Évaluation pratique en pair-programming (Algo, Python, SQL) avec trois Sfeirians. 

- Échange Métier & Projection : Discussion approfondie sur les cas d'usage, les missions cibles et le contexte client à Toulouse 

- Entretien Final : Échange stratégique avec le Directeur d'Agence. 

Prêt·e à passer au niveau supérieur sans renoncer à tes valeurs ? Postule et viens rencontrer le collectif !

title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
description:
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

- High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.

- High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.

- High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.

- Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

- Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.

- Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.

- Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.

- Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.

- Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.

- Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.

- Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.

- Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

- You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.

- You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.

- You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.

- You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.

- You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with

Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 

What you bring

Must have 

- Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms

- Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design

- Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents

- A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day

- Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams

- Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal

- Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions

- Clear, structured documentation habits

- Fluent English and French skills

- Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus 

- Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)

- Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations

- Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects

- Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms

- SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

- Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter

- Customer satisfaction with your contribution

- Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents

- Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern

- Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

- Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.

- Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.

- Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

What We Offer 

Culture & Growth 

- A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.

- Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.

- Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.

- Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.

- Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle 

- Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.

- Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.

- Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.

- Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

How you make an impact joining Apaleo: Joining Apaleo means more than just taking on a role it's about driving real change in the hospitality industry. Your contributions will directly shape our innovative platform, influence company-wide decisions, and help redefine the future of hospitality tech. At Apaleo, your voice matters, your ideas are valued, and your impact is tangible. Be part of a team where your work fuels progress, collaboration sparks innovation, and growth is a shared journey.

description:
ENGLISH VERSION 

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne , c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable . Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain .

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur ! 

Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. 

Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure. 

🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe. 

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous 

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet ANR PRME LINEN ( Experimental and Numerical Characterisation of Flax Composite Manufacturing by Liquid Infusion: From Local Phenomena to Induced Properties ), auquel participent plusieurs chercheurs de l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne , avec pour objectif d’étudier l’élaboration de pièces structurales en matériaux composites à base de fibres de lin.

Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 12 mois est proposé pour développer la modélisation numérique de l’infusion de résine dans des préformes composites à fibres de lin. L’objectif est d’étudier, à l’échelle mésoscopique, l’influence de l’organisation anisotrope et hétérogène des torons de fibres sur l’écoulement de la résine. Le projet s’appuiera sur des simulations 3D par éléments finis , reposant sur un couplage Stokes-Darcy et la prise en compte d’un tenseur de perméabilité orthotrope. Une attention particulière sera portée à l’influence des variations locales de la fraction volumique de fibres sur la perméabilité, les chemins préférentiels d’écoulement et les effets capillaires. Les simulations seront réalisées avec le code éléments finis Cœur ( https://gitlab.emse.fr/bruchon/Coeur ) , en s’appuyant sur la bibliothèque PETSc et des solveurs itératifs préconditionnés adaptés aux problèmes de grande taille. Dans un premier temps, des architectures idéalisées de type unidirectionnel, quasi-unidirectionnel et tissé seront étudiées à l’aide d’une représentation par Level-Set . Dans un second temps, lorsque cela sera possible, des mésostructures réalistes seront reconstruites à partir d’images µ-CT . 

Le post-doctorant.e contribuera également au développement et à la validation de la stratégie numérique et travaillera en interaction étroite avec les travaux expérimentaux et numériques des autres tâches du projet. 

🔍 Ce que nous recherchons 

Une formation en mécanique numérique, mécanique des fluides, éléments finis ou calcul scientifique est recherchée. 

Des compétences en C++/Python, calcul haute performance, PETSc, méthodes Level-Set ou traitement d’images 3D seront appréciées.

Vous vous reconnaissez dans les capacités et aptitudes suivantes : 

· Capacité à travailler en équipe

· Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs académiques et industriels

title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
description:
Contexte : 

Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.

L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).

Présentation d’Artefact : 

Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.

Sujet : 

Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.

Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.

Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.

Pré-requis 

Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :
BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur
Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études
Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027
Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Références 

- Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., & Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision , 64 (6), 672-689.

- Buolamwini, J., & Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency (pp. 77-91). PMLR.

- Cho, J., Zala, A., & Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.

- Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., & Liu, X. (2023). Dark-skin individuals are at more risk on the street: Unmasking fairness issues of autonomous driving systems. CoRR abs/2308.02935 .

- Thong, W., Joniak, P., & Xiang, A. (2023, October). Beyond skin tone: A multidimensional measure of apparent skin color. In 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) (pp. 4880-4890). IEEE.

- Shilova, V., Malherbe, E., Palma, G., Risser, L., & Loubes, J. M. (2025). Fairness-aware grouping for continuous sensitive variables: Application for debiasing face analysis with respect to skin tone. In ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy-Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025) Proceedings (pp. 5344-5351).

- Mary, J., Calauzenes, C., & El Karoui, N. (2019, May). Fairness-aware learning for continuous attributes and treatments. In International conference on machine learning (pp. 4382-4391). PMLR.

- Giuliani, L., Misino, E., & Lombardi, M. (2023, July). Generalized disparate impact for configurable fairness solutions in ML. In International Conference on Machine Learning (pp. 11443-11458). PMLR.

This is a Research Engineer position. What you'll bring

- MSc (or equivalent, in progress) in robotics, mechanical engineering, or a closely related field, with a thesis or capstone project on manipulation, teleoperation, or retargeting

- Hands-on experience building a data collection device or system for robot learning (UMI or a comparable system), not just operating one someone else built

- Working knowledge of retargeting algorithms for mapping human input onto robot hands or end-effectors

- 1 to 2 years of combined research, internship, or industry experience in robotics, mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline

- Software and systems engineering skills strong enough to build and maintain infrastructure other engineers rely on, not only research-grade prototypes

About the role: 

ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.

You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

What You’ll Be Doing: 

- Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments.

- Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability.

- Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS.

- Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster.

- Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

- Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you.

- Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale.

- Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.

- Practical AI experience: you’ve used AI to solve real problems in production – not just experimented. You understand context management, prompt engineering, agent testing, and integration tradeoffs.

- Comfort with ambiguity: you make sound judgment calls without a playbook and document what you learn.

- Experience in a customer-facing engineering or professional services role.

- Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
description:
Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 

You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence 

- Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

- Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

- Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

- Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership 

- Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

- Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

- Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

- Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement 

- Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. 

- Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. 

- Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. 

What We Want to Achieve Together 

In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. 

In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. 

Your profile - Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. 

- Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. 

- Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. 

- Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. 

- AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. 

- A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. 

- Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. 

Why us? - Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. 

- A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. 

- Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. 

- Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. 

- Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. 

Process - 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. 

- Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. 

- Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. 

- Meet the team in the office. 

- Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team! 

How to Apply 

Send us your CV, two or three writing or work samples you’re proud of, and a short note answering: what’s your sharpest point of view on where Legal AI is heading, and what’s the evidence?

title: Legal AI Engineer (Zurich)
description:
Description Legartis is on a mission: to unlock legal work at scale.

We set the standard for AI-powered contract work by offering a platform that changes how legal teams work, from drafting through negotiation to completion. We are now looking for the person who turns what customers actually need into what our AI actually does.

Joining Legartis is not taking a job, you take ownership. We are a team of product builders and lawyers, who do not chase hype; we build substance. If you are a lawyer who builds, someone who has stopped waiting for better tools and started making them, this is your moment and your place.

Send us your CV, a short note on why Legartis, and links to anything you have built or published.

Your mission Most companies split this seat across three teams, and that split is exactly the problem. The person who hears the customer describe their workflow should be the person who writes the requirement, and the person who writes the requirement should be able to build the first version themselves. That is you.

1. You translate customer reality into engineering requirements — and into revenue. You sit in customer and expert calls alongside Sales, not as a note-taker but as the person who understands the legal work. In trials and hackathons you coach hands-on: the customer drives, you navigate, and they create the first "wow" moment themselves. When they say "that won't work for us" or "we'll build it ourselves", you answer with a concrete path (a workaround, a workflow, the honest maintenance cost of the alternative) and you leave every conversation with a next step: trial licenses, a hackathon, a scoped rollout. Then you pull out the workflow: what actually happens, in what order, where it breaks, what the customer would pay to never do again. And you write the spec, edge cases, and acceptance criteria that Engineering can build against.

2. You build the skills yourself. You write, test, and ship agent skills and playbooks that solve real customer workflows. You build the evaluation frameworks and test sets that prove they got better rather than just different. When the AI fails on a clause, you diagnose why, at the prompt and context level, and you either fix it or hand Engineering a diagnosis precise enough to act on.

3. You make it repeatable, and therefore sellable. Anything you build once for one customer, you turn into something Sales and Customer Success can run without you. Standard demo environments. A skill library they can reach for. Onboarding that lands in days rather than months. Where Customer Success needs legal depth you step in, fix it, and turn the fix into something the team can handle alone next time. Your success is measured by how rarely you need to be in the room, and by what happens to adoption and expansion when you are not.

4. You are the legal authority in the building. Legal and compliance questions land with you: contract reviews, customer security and data protection questions, the occasional in-house matter which makes roughly ten to fifteen percent of your time. You use our own product to do it, and you tell us honestly when it is not good enough.

Your profile The person we picture. There is a name emerging for what we are describing, and it is not "lawyer who is good with computers". It is legal quant : a lawyer who builds their own tooling to practise law, rather than waiting for a vendor to ship it. The distinction that matters to us: plenty of lawyers now use AI. title: Production Engineer
description:
As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

Responsibilities and Duties 

- Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.

- Plan and execute product verification, covering test case definition, execution, analysis, and comprehensive documentation, also for repair guidance.

- Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).

- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams by offering technical guidance and hands-on support for testing and validation of advanced avionics PCBs and modular systems.

- Specify and document additional manufacturer tests (like flying probe) to allow for a layered, holistic approach to test coverage.

- Write Repair Guides that document the error cases and the affected components.

- Guide manufacturers with new product integrations usually in person in the factory.

- Manage tracking systems across multiple locations to inspect the product workflow.

- Support internal CI systems with real hardware to validate test procedures before upgrading test fixtures at OEMs.

Qualifications and Skills 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field.

- Proficiency in modern Python and C/C++ also applied to embedded systems.

- 5+ years of experience in programming software that runs on real hardware and testing it on real hardware.

- CAD experience (e.g., Onshape) and soldering skills are required.

- Practical experience in Linux, microcontroller programming, 3D printing, and related prototyping tools.

- Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.

- Good verbal and written English communication skills.

Benefits 

- Flexible working hours

- Stock Options

- Generous holiday allowance

- Company pension plan 

- Car parking 

- Enhanced maternity & paternity leave

- Mental health and wellbeing support

- Learning and development opportunities

About Pallet 

Pallet is building AI Agents to transform the physical economy — a $12 trillion global industry. We’ve raised $50M from top investors, including General Catalyst, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Bain Capital Ventures. In under two years, we’ve achieved 700% revenue growth and are just getting started.

Our mission is to increase the efficiency of the global supply chain by automating the manual workflows that slow supply chain teams down — from scheduling and appointment setting to data entry and load management. Our flagship platform provides end-to-end visibility, control, and optimization, while our newest product, CoPallet, introduces AI Agents that can understand and execute requests in real time and integrate directly with customer systems.

As companies across the physical economy look to generative AI to drive efficiency, many are turning to Pallet to lead the way. With deep supply chain expertise and cutting-edge AI capabilities, we’re positioned to build the next $10B company powering the physical economy.

Join us and work alongside leaders from Google, DoorDash, YC, and more to shape the future of supply chain technology.

London, United Kingdom or Zurich, Switzerland (Remote to start, transitioning to 5 days/week in-office once our local office opens) 

You could be an Enterprise Account Executive anywhere. Why us? 

- Join a well-funded, high-growth startup on a clear path to $100M ARR.

- Sell a category-defining AI Agents platform with massive surface area across logistics.

- Build Pallet’s presence across Europe as one of the first commercial hires on the ground.

- Work directly with founders and senior leadership to define our international go-to-market strategy.

- Help transform one of the world’s largest industries while building toward a $10B+ outcome.

About the opportunity 

We’re hiring our first Enterprise Account Executives in EMEA to build Pallet’s commercial presence across Europe.

You’ll own net-new enterprise acquisition across the region, build relationships with the largest logistics providers in Europe, and help establish the playbook for our international expansion. This is a highly consultative enterprise sales role focused on educating customers on an entirely new category of AI-powered workflow automation.

You’ll partner closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Solutions, and Customer Success to drive a solution-selling motion centered around workflow discovery, AI use case identification, structured pilots, and measurable ROI.

Initially, this role will be remote from London while we establish our UK presence. Once our London office opens, this role will transition to working from the office five days per week when not traveling to customer sites.

How you will make an impact 

- Own the full enterprise sales cycle across EMEA, from outbound prospecting through contract signature.

- Build and maintain a 3x-4x qualified pipeline through disciplined outbound execution while self-sourcing at least 30% of opportunities.

- Develop relationships with executive stakeholders across Europe’s largest logistics providers, including COO, CIO, VP Operations, VP Supply Chain, and VP Technology.

- Lead consultative discovery sessions that map operational workflows to Pallet’s AI agent capabilities.

- Scope and lead structured pilots that demonstrate measurable operational ROI and convert into enterprise deployments.

- Build executive business cases that align operational improvements with financial outcomes.

- Document repeatable customer use cases and market feedback to shape Pallet’s product roadmap and international GTM strategy.

- Help establish Pallet as the leading AI platform for enterprise logistics across Europe.

What we’re looking for 

- 8+ years of enterprise B2B SaaS or enterprise logistics sales experience.

- Business-fluent Spanish you can run discovery, negotiate and present to executives in Spanish. 

- Proven track record of consistently closing six- and seven-figure enterprise software agreements.

- Strong consultative selling and value-based sales methodology.

- Experience navigating complex buying committees and long enterprise sales cycles.

- Executive presence with senior operators and technology leaders.

- Comfortable selling technical, workflow-heavy software products.

- Ability to quickly understand complex logistics operations and translate them into compelling AI automation opportunities.

- Excellent outbound prospecting and territory-building discipline.

- Willingness to travel extensively across Europe.

Experience selling into logistics, supply chain, transportation, or warehouse operations is strongly preferred but not required. Candidates without logistics experience should demonstrate an ability to quickly learn operational workflows and become trusted advisors to customers.

Working model 

Working hours are generally 9:00am-6:00pm London time , providing full coverage of the European business day while maintaining regular collaboration with our San Francisco headquarters.

You’ll typically spend:

- Mornings and early afternoons working directly with European customers and prospects.

- Late afternoons collaborating with our US-based Sales, Product, and Engineering teams during our daily overlap window.

- Approximately 75% of your time traveling across Europe for customer meetings, executive workshops, pilots, and industry events.

Initially this role will be remote. Once Pallet opens its local office, you’ll work from the office five days per week whenever you’re not traveling to customers.

Reporting structure 

You’ll report directly to the General Manager, London for territory strategy, customer relationships, and international expansion.

You’ll also work closely with our Head of Sales , participating in weekly pipeline reviews, forecasting, and sales process alignment with the US team.

Interview Process 

- Chat with Christy - Business Recruiter - 30 mins

- Deal Review - 30 mins

- Discovery Mock Interview - 45-60 mins

- Final Interview - ~3 hours

- Brief Background Check and Reference Check

We move fast, and we’ll keep you informed at every stage of the process.

Compensation 

The estimated compensation range for this role is £100,000-£240,000 OTE , depending on experience and skill set.

Our compensation follows a standard 50/50 enterprise sales structure consisting of base salary and target commission. High performers are eligible for uncapped commission accelerators above quota.

In addition to cash compensation, we offer competitive equity, benefits, and significant growth opportunities as one of our earliest international commercial hires.

Final compensation will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated enterprise sales performance.

Our Benefits 

We invest in our people the same way we invest in our product: seriously.

- 🩺 Health, Vision, and Dental benefits 

- 🏝️ Take-what-you-need Paid Vacation

- ➕ Life Insurance and Accidental Insurance 

- ❤️‍🩹 Short-Term Disability Coverage

- 💸 Generous salary and equity for all staff

- 🪜 401k option; helping you save for the future

- 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Paid parental leave to support growing families

- 📚 Yearly learning and development stipend

- 🚌 Commuter benefits for Bay Area employees

- 🚘 Uber ride stipend if you ever have to work late in the office 

- 🏡 Remote office home stipend to get you comfy in your space

- 🍔 Daily catered lunches provided 

- ✈️ Onboarding trip to San Francisco HQ if you work remotely

- 🥤 Monthly happy hours

- 🎉 Annual Company Offsites; our last one was in Palm Springs CA 🌴

Workplace Policy 

We are an in-person company. Our offices in San Francisco, New York City and London are where ideas get built, decisions get made, and the team gets stronger. We have invested in making them genuinely great places to spend your day, with catered lunches, monthly happy hours, and people who care about the work and each other.

Most of our team works in office five days a week. For select roles, we hire remotely across the U.S. Remote employees come to one of our offices for their first week to onboard and meet the team, and we cover the full trip. 

Every role is different. Travel expectations are always shared upfront in the job description and confirmed in your first call with us.

Equal Opportunity 

Pallet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, disability status, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic. We prohibit any form of discrimination or harassment. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring.

Candidate Privacy Notice 

Please review Pallet’s Candidate Privacy Notice here .

Accommodations 

Pallet complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), as amended by the ADA Amendments Act, and all applicable state or local laws. We will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with a disability during the application process and throughout employment as required by law.

title: Director, International Privacy Lead and Data Protection Officer
description:
Director, International Privacy Lead & Data Protection Officer 

Overview 

Alnylam is seeking an experienced privacy and data protection leader to serve as Director, International Privacy Lead & Data Protection Officer. Reporting to the Senior Director, Head of Privacy, AI Governance, Training & Communications within Ethics & Compliance, this role will lead Alnylam’s international privacy program, with primary responsibility for Europe (EU/EEA, United Kingdom, and Switzerland) and support for broader international markets.

As Alnylam’s formally appointed Data Protection Officer (DPO) under applicable European and Swiss privacy laws, the Director will provide independent privacy oversight, advise the business on data protection obligations, and maintain direct access and escalation channels to senior leadership for material privacy risks.

This individual contributor will be expected to serve as a proactive partner to the our international business, anticipating privacy and data protection obligations driven by regulatory change and business growth, and translating those requirements into actionable guidance for policies, operations and ways of working.

The successful candidate will partner closely with Legal, Information Security, IT, HR, Commercial, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Pharmacovigilance, Procurement, Ethics & Compliance, and other business stakeholders to enable responsible use of personal data while strengthening privacy governance, risk management, and business adoption across international markets.

Hybrid role preferably based in Zug, Switzerland. Also open to candidates based in Madrid, Spain or Maidenhead, UK.

Responsibilities 

- Lead and mature Alnylam’s international privacy program, with primary focus on Europe and support for broader international markets, by setting program priorities, strengthening governance frameworks, and ensuring privacy requirements are embedded into business planning, policies, controls, and day-to-day operations.

- Serve as Alnylam’s appointed DPO under EU GDPR, UK GDPR, and applicable Swiss data protection requirements, providing independent advice, monitoring compliance, maintaining required independence, and acting as the primary point of contact for supervisory authorities and data subjects.

- Oversee privacy risk identification, assessment, mitigation, monitoring, and escalation processes, including privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default requirements, DPIAs, TIAs, Records of Processing Activities (ROPA), cross-border transfer assessments, and related governance documentation.

- Advise business and functional leaders on privacy requirements related to clinical research, pharmacovigilance, commercial operations, medical affairs, human resources, patient support programs, real-world evidence, AI, and other data-driven initiatives.

- Partner with Information Security, Legal, Procurement, and business stakeholders on privacy incident response, breach assessment, third-party privacy risk management, data protection terms, data sharing arrangements, remediation, and regulatory notification decisions.

- Proactively monitor the European and international privacy, AI, digital, cyber and data governance legislative landscape, anticipating compliance impacts from business growth and regulatory change, and rapidly translating new or changing requirements into practical updates to policies, controls, business processes, training, and operational guidance.

- Develop and deliver privacy training, communications, awareness initiatives, metrics, monitoring activities, and continuous improvement plans that promote a culture of privacy and accountability across international markets.

Qualifications 

Required 

- Juris Doctor (JD), LLM, or other advanced legal degree required.

- 12+ years of privacy legal or compliance experience at a law firm and/or in-house.

- Significant experience advising on privacy risk in regulated life sciences settings, including clinical research, pharmacovigilance, medical affairs, commercial, HR, patient-facing, and digital activities.

- Experience serving as a DPO or advising in an equivalent independent oversight capacity for GDPR, UK GDPR, Swiss FADP, or comparable privacy regimes.

- Deep understanding of GDPR, UK GDPR, Swiss FADP, international data transfer requirements, and global privacy regulations.

- Experience advising on AI, data-driven innovation, real-world evidence, cross-border data use, and other strategic privacy initiatives.

- Strong privacy governance and risk management experience, including the ability to set priorities, mature program controls, and translate complex requirements into practical guidance for technical and non-technical audiences.

- Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the credibility and judgment to engage senior leaders, regulators, external partners, and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Proven ability to lead complex privacy initiatives across matrixed, international organizations, applying practical and proportionate judgment to ambiguous issues.

- Executive presence, regulatory credibility, and strategic judgment to anticipate legal, business, and technology shifts and translate them into clear priorities for the international privacy program.

Preferred 

- Privacy certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT, AIGP, or similar credentials preferred.

- Experience interacting directly with European data protection authorities and regulators preferred.

- Experience leading multinational privacy teams or global privacy programs preferred.

- International business experience within a global life sciences organization preferred.

About Alnylam: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (Nasdaq: ALNY) has led the translation of RNA interference (RNAi) into a whole new class of innovative medicines with the potential to transform the lives of people afflicted with rare and more prevalent diseases. Based on Nobel Prize-winning science, RNAi therapeutics represent a powerful, clinically validated approach to treating diseases at their genetic source by “interfering” with mRNA that cause or contribute to disease. Since our founding in 2002, Alnylam has led the RNAi Revolution and continues to turn scientific possibility into reality.

Our culture: Our people-first culture is guided by our core values: fiercely innovative, open culture, purposeful urgency, passion for excellence, and commitment to people, and these values influence how we work and the business decisions we make. Thanks to feedback from our employees over the years, we’ve been fortunate to be named a top employer around the world. Alnylam is extremely proud to have been recognized as one of Science Magazine’s Top Biopharma Employers, one of America's Most Responsible Companies for 2024 by Newsweek, a Fast Company Best Workplace for Innovators, and a Great Place to Work in Canada, France, Italy, Spain, Switzerland, and UK – among others.

At Alnylam, we commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equal employment opportunity. We are dedicated to building an environment where employees can feel that they belong, can bring their authentic selves to work, and achieve to their full potential. By empowering employees to embrace their unique differences at work, our business grows stronger with advanced and original thinking, allowing us to bring groundbreaking medicines to patients.

title: Infrastructure Software Engineer
description:
Join our mission 

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products. 

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role 

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

Own the software that drives our hardware. You'll write the control planes, automation, and observability that keep our global fleet fast, efficient, and reliable, while charting a path to scale that continues to increase the number of "machines under management" per engineer.

Our culture 

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do 

- Manage and automate the fleet – build services for provisioning, health checks, upgrades, and incident remediation

- Uphold reliability – embed observability, graceful degradation, and rollback paths into every layer you touch

- Architect the network – design and evolve a high-throughput, low-latency fabric tailored to our high performance use-cases

- Ship software, not scripts – develop clean, testable code (mostly Go) that treats our fleet like a first-class API

- Drive efficiency – improve utilization and power-to-performance ratios so capacity grows slower than usage

- Partner across the stack – work with product, infra, and platform teams to scope and deliver features like storage-aware scheduling, cache volumes, and other developer-facing features

What we're looking for 

- Proven experience engineering large-scale infrastructure - writing the software that runs fleets, not just operating existing hyperscalers

- Depth in network architecture, data-center design, and performance tuning

- Hands-on time deploying and managing compute hardware at scale (servers, switches, etc)

- Fluency with modern orchestration and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible - plus the judgment to know when to build vs. buy)

- A track record of delivering reliable systems and measurable efficiency gains

You can expect: 

- Competitive salary and stock options

- Flexible working hours

- Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs: 

- We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

- We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

- We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.
