title: Project Planner (Data Centres/Buildings/High-tech/Infrastructure) -  Frankfurt/Berlin/Munich (Hybrid)
description:
Are you a bit tired of the standard, old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry? 

Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology? 

Have you always cared about the importance of proper planning and the connection between the schedule and the real, day-to-day delivery of the job? 

Have you ever wanted to work a bit more flexibly but still be hands-on in construction and improving the industry? 

Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t. It’s quite real! Read on. 

____________________________________________________________ 

We are Laminar Projects! 

If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered. 

Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. ( Check out our short film about it. ) 

We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. ( Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.) 

The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. ( Read more about our vision and missions .) 

This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. 

( Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos. ) 

Core values for a good life 

A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has: 

- Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself 

- Care about people – your relationship with others around you 

- Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team 

- Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world 

We enshrined our values in our vision: 

We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that: 

- Connects us with meaningful relationships 

- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans 

- Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 

By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world. 

And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions: 

- To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation 

- To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society 

____________________________________________________________ 

The Role 

Purpose of the role 

You’ll be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning to the very highest standards. You’ll devise strategies and tactics to improve the way the project is delivered. You’ll translate this knowledge into a logic-linked plan and analyse it using planning software. Then you’ll use the plan to help the teams understand what to prioritise. 

Your team 

This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy team which focuses on: 

- Understanding what the real problems of projects are 

- Implementing the best solutions to those problems 

- Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology 

More specifically, you’ll be part of our Project Planning Team, who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors. 

Your top three objectives 

1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection 

2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems 

3. To develop yourself and everyone around you 

Your top five responsibilities 

1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project is working to it effectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially 

2. Own the outcome: You're responsible for putting in your best effort to ensure the project team’s understanding and focus on the plan – no matter how stubborn they are 

3. Report and inform: Provide simple, actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project more efficiently and effectively 

4. Make scalable solutions : Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved 

5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well 

You must have: 

- A construction engineering background: You have at least 2+ years of experience on construction projects, experience in project planning both software and principles, as well as decent Excel skills, and a strong interest in data 

- Communication skills: You’re proficient in written and verbal English and have the charisma and influence to get construction people to do new things and take the best approach 

- Leadership capabilities: You lead yourself proactively and lead others by asking the right questions and challenging them 

- Impact: You have a track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics – implementing scalable, repeatable solutions that had a significant positive impact 

Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: 

- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge 

- You like to be the smartest person in the room 

- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback 

- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team 

____________________________________________________________ 

Frequently Asked Questions 

What kinds of projects would I be working on? 

It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres , infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects . These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. ( Check out our case stories .) 

Who are our clients? 

Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. 

Where would I be working? 

One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. 

How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? 

You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. 

The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. 

____________________________________________________________ 

Benefits 

The standard stuff: 

- Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future - with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance 

- Professional body membership. One fee covered per year - so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft 

The life-changing stuff: 

- In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally - professionally and as a human being 

- Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future - and own a piece of it 

- Flexible working. Work where it makes sense - most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins 

- Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up 

____________________________________________________________ 

Important! Applying properly 

We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining: 

- Why you want to join us 

- What you’ll bring to the team 

We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix. 

This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility.

title: Senior Data Scientist, Growth (f/m/x)
description:
About the role: What's in the Box 

The Growth Alliance powers HelloFresh ’s marketing engine, from media investment and in-channel optimization, to the conversion funnel, to how and when we communicate with customers. As a Senior Data Scientist , you will design and ship statistical and machine learning models that turn data from experiments, campaigns, and customer behavior into decisions that directly move the business: how we spend our marketing budget, how we convert visitors into customers, and how we personalize every touchpoint along the way.

You’ll join one of several teams within the alliance, spanning marketing measurement and attribution, channel optimisation, funnel optimisation and decisioning on customer communications and messaging. Across all of these topics, the through line is the same: rigorous modeling, close collaboration with engineering and marketing stakeholders, and a bias toward shipping models that work in production, not just in a notebook.

To succeed in this role, you should be a curious, pragmatic problem solver who relentlessly prioritizes based on impact, is comfortable with statistical uncertainty, and can translate a fuzzy business question into a concrete, testable model.

At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.

What you’ll do: The Recipe 

- Design, build, and take ownership of statistical and machine learning models, from data collection through to production, closely aligning the approach with non-technical stakeholders.

- Collaborate within cross-functional teams (engineering, product, marketing) to translate business objectives into concrete, data-driven strategies.

- Experimentation: design tests, define success metrics and guardrails, and interpret results while accounting for statistical uncertainty, noise, and bias.

- Continuously iterate and refine your technical approach, monitor model performance, data reliability, and drift once in production.

- Retrieve, manipulate, and analyze large, heterogeneous datasets, and build the data pipelines your models depend on.

- Think beyond the immediate ask to find new ways to improve the data products delivered to stakeholders.

- As a senior member of the team, jump in to help solve problems as they arise, and support and coach more junior data scientists.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients 

- Proven track record of scientific work through a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in statistics, physics, economics, mathematics, data science, or a related quantitative field.

- 3+ years of professional experience as a (senior) data scientist or in a related quantitative role, ideally in e-commerce, marketing, or a comparably high-traffic, consumer-facing environment.

- Strong marketing and/or growth domain knowledge, with experience applying statistical models such as regressors and classifiers, and interpreting experiment results under real-world uncertainty.

- Fluency in Python and its scientific stack (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib); comfortable retrieving and analyzing data with SQL. Experience with Databricks/Spark is a plus.

- Familiarity with software engineering practices and tools (Git, Docker, AWS or similar cloud environments).

- Comfortable using recent Gen AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) to design and build solutions in a structured and pragmatic manner.

- A critical thinker and creative problem solver who is comfortable proposing and prioritizing multiple solutions based on effort and likely impact.

- A collaborative team player with exceptional communication skills, able to work with stakeholders from different backgrounds in an international environment.

Nice to have (domain specific), if you find yourself in one of the below, it’s a huge plus! 

- Measurement & attribution: experience with media mix models, attribution modeling, or incrementality measurement; Bayesian forecasting and estimating model uncertainty.

- Search or Social channel optimization: experience with the Google/Meta ecosystem or other paid channels, forecasting algorithms, portfolio optimization, or Vector Autoregression.

- Conversion & personalization: experience building decisioning or recommendation models that run in production behind high-traffic conversion funnels; customer segmentation and behavioral data.

- Messaging & send decisioning: direct experience with reinforcement learning or contextual bandits (e.g. Thompson Sampling, epsilon-greedy), off-policy/counterfactual evaluation, or CRM and marketing decisioning use cases.

What we offer: The Toppings 

- Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

- Technology with real-world impact: Build and operate modern systems at global scale, supporting 6+ millions of customers and complex supply chain operations.

- Technical/Product/Design leadership: Drive best practices and influence architecture/design, quality, and ways of working in an autonomous, product-led setup.

- End-to-end development/delivery: Drive decisions from problem definition to production, improving systems and enabling long-term scalability.

Are you the missing ingredient? If this sounds like a tasty opportunity, we’d be excited to hear from you. We aim to review your profile and respond within 5 business days.

title: Associate Director, Paid Strategy (all genders)
description:
The role 

Global Paid Marketing owns how HelloFresh Group buys customers across its portfolio of brands and markets. The team spans Paid Social, Paid Search, Display & Video, Partnerships & Affiliates, Creative Strategy and the Creators program, and steers one of the largest acquisition budgets in direct-to-consumer. We are rebuilding the organization around fewer, stronger channel leaders and an AI-first way of working, and this role is central to making that model run.

We are looking for an Associate Director of Paid Strategy to own the strategy, planning and operating backbone of Global Paid Marketing. Reporting to the Head of Global Paid Marketing, you will set how the paid portfolio plans its budget, runs its business reviews and prioritizes and delivers its biggest bets.

Channel leaders own their numbers. You own the system around them: the plan they commit to, the cadence that holds them to it, the cross-channel programs no single team owns, and the insightsthat turns many channels and dozens of entities into one clear view of the business. It is a role with unusual breadth and visibility, built for someone who wants to understand how a large paid organization is run, not just how one channel performs.

You will work directly with the paid leadership team, with StratOps as your closest partner: StratOps sets the company-wide growth agenda and governance, and you translate it into how paid team plans, operates and reports, then bring the paid view back into that agenda. You will also partner closely with Finance, Analytics, HR and Brand. This role is primarily designed as an Individual Contributor position: ; your impact comes from the quality of your thinking, the rigor of your follow-through and the trust you earn.

Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you. 

What you’ll do 

Paid strategy and planning 

- Own the planning cycle for the global paid portfolio: annual Business Plan, half-year budgets and monthly MBT re-forecasts, from channel-mix and entity allocation through to CAC and volume guardrails.

- Partner with StratOps and Finance so paid commitments tie to company targets, and pressure-test every submission based on run-rates and data-driven assumptions 

- Shape the multi-year paid strategy: where to invest, where to pull back, and which capabilities the organization needs to build.

Operating rhythm and governance 

- Design and run the operating cadence of the paid organization: weekly and monthly business reviews, QBRs, leadership team meetings and senior leadership steerings.

- Set agendas, write or commission pre-reads, and own the decision and action log so every meeting ends with an owner and a date, and every commitment is followed through.

- Define the KPIs, targets and reporting standards that let leadership compare channels and entities on one consistent basis.

Cross-channel programs 

- Lead the high-priority initiatives that span channels and no single team owns, such as measurement and incrementality, partner and agency consolidation, and AI adoption across the team.

- Run them with clear scope, milestones and owners, and escalate early when they drift.

- Conduct and synthesize ad hoc strategic analysis to support paid leadership with decision marking or problem solving

Insight and executive communication 

- Turn performance across channels and entities into a single, narrative for senior leadership: CMO updates, QBRs, steering decks and budget reviews.

- Ensure high quality and consistent deliverable from the Paid team to Leadership to enable fast and informed decision making 

Organization and capability planning 

- Support org design, headcount and people-cost planning for Global Paid Marketing, working with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition.

- Track priority hiring and internal moves, and keep one source of truth for the team's structure and capacity.

- Drive knowledge transfer and best-practice sharing across channels and markets.

AI-enabled operations 

- Use AI to automate recurring reporting, business-review preparation and forecasting, freeing leaders' time for decisions.

- Assess and introduce AI tools that improve planning, budget optimization and insight generation, and hold their output to account.

What you’ll bring 

- 6+ years in strategy and operations, growth strategy, management consulting or performance marketing at scale, including time close to senior decision-makers.

- A strong quantitative foundation: you can build a budget or forecast model, read an experiment, and defend a recommendation with data rather than opinion. SQL or equivalent is a plus.

- Fluency in marketing economics: CAC, payback, incrementality, and how budget, channel mix and volume trade off against each other.

- Proven ability to run complex, cross-functional programs and to influence senior peers without direct authority.

- Executive-level communication: you write crisp pre-reads, build decks that make a point on page one, and can tell leadership what they need to hear.

- Sound judgment and discretion with confidential information, including budgets, organization plans and people topics.

- Hands-on use of AI to compress real analytical or operational work, not just as a search engine.

- Comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities; you bring structure where there is none and keep many threads moving at once.

Bonus points if you have owned a planning or budget cycle end to end, worked in a multi-brand or multi-market organization, or come from a top-tier consulting or strategy program.

What success looks like in your first year 

- The paid operating cadence runs on a fixed calendar, with standard pre-reads and a decision log that leadership trusts and uses.

- The next Business Plan and half-year budget submissions go in on time, from one source of truth, with every material assumption pressure-tested.

- Two or three cross-channel programs have landed with measurable impact on CAC, volume or team productivity.

Motion is currently the most exciting greenfield area of our brand identity. We are looking for an entrepreneurial motion designer to define our motion principles, build scalable systems, and elevate our visual storytelling across all touchpoints.

Your Responsibilities 

- Define Motion Principles: Shape how the Raisin brand expresses itself through movement, establishing distinct principles for timing, easing, transitions, and typographic behavior.

- Product & UI Visualization: Collaborate with Web and Product Design teams to create clear product animations and UI micro-interactions (delivered in production-ready formats like Lottie or Rive) that explain savings, investment, and pension concepts simply and transparently.

- End-to-End Ownership: Lead motion projects from concept to final export, including storyboards, styleframes, animation, QA, and oversight of external creative agencies or production partners.

- Mentorship & Culture: Share motion expertise across the broader design team, empowering non-motion designers to think in movement and elevating the team's craft standard.

- Workflow Innovation: Explore emerging tools (including AI-assisted workflows) to streamline repetitive task execution without compromising visual quality.

Your Profile 

- 5+ years of motion design experience, in-house or agency, ideally for fintech, tech, or brand-driven companies.

- A strong portfolio showing brand motion work and marketing work: identity systems, campaigns, social content, and product or UI animation.

- Expert in After Effects, Jitter, and Figma; highly proficient with the Adobe Creative Suite.

- A deep understanding of animation principles (timing, easing, staging, rhythm) and how motion communicates brand character.

- Proven track record of thinking in systems, building motion templates, libraries, and workflows that enable other designers to produce consistent work at scale.

- A solid understanding of paid and organic social: formats, safe zones, pacing, and what makes someone stop scrolling.

- Du sprichst weitere Sprachen neben Deutsch und Englisch.

Team Spirit feiern wir regelmäßig: mit 3 großen Team Events im Jahr, 2 monatlichen lockeren Formaten in unserem HQ und einer starken Recognition Culture, in der wir kleine wie große Erfolge sichtbar machen und gemeinsam zelebrieren.

title: Senior Product Manager - Salesforce & Internal Enablement (all genders)
description:
Responsibilities We are looking for an experienced, passionate, and hands-on Senior Product Manager to join our product team and empower Aroundhome’s core business operations for our next phase of growth. 

Aroundhome is Germany's leading platform for home projects, connecting thousands of homeowners with the right local service partners. The Internal Enablement team owns the core CRM and operational infrastructure -primarily built on Salesforce- that powers our sales teams and customer care in the future. By transforming fragmented, legacy setups into a scalable, automated core, your work directly enables our business teams to drive growth and deliver a seamless experience to our partner network. 

At Aroundhome, Product Managers play a pivotal role in shaping our platform’s success. We work in a domain-based model, where each cross-functional product team has full ownership over a clearly defined part of the platform. This structure fosters close collaboration and ensures that expertise for continuous product discovery and iterative improvement sits directly within each domain. 

As a Senior Product Manager for Internal Enablement, you will translate our growth strategies into a clear future-state vision for our operational ecosystem. You will drive process automation, data consistency, and core tool integration, ensuring our platform can scale efficiently as we significantly expand our business. 

- As a Senior Product Manager, you define and execute a strategic product roadmap that translates our growth goals into a modern, future-proof Salesforce ecosystem. 
- You combine user research, process analysis, and quantitative data to identify root problems and systematically validate high-impact opportunities. 
- You challenge legacy workflows to design reusable capabilities, clean data flows, and clear technical boundaries between Salesforce and connected systems. 
- You make evidence-based decisions to prioritize your backlog, focusing relentlessly on business growth and operational scalability. 
- You partner closely with Salesforce Architects, Salesforce Administrators, Data and Engineers to manage the product lifecycle and release testable, incremental value quickly. 
- You align business stakeholders across Sales and Operations, actively guiding internal teams through training, change management and process adoption. 
- You track clear success metrics to measure operational efficiency gains, while exploring AI applications to continuously optimize workflows and user outcomes. 

Skills - Proven track record as a Senior Product Manager driving large-scale CRM transformations, with deep hands-on expertise in the Salesforce ecosystem (certifications are a strong plus). 
- Expertise in continuous product discovery and translating high-level business goals into measurable, outcome-based metrics. 
- Strong understanding of system architecture, data synchronization, and API-based integrations between Salesforce and complex adjacent tools. 
- Exceptional communication and storytelling skills to align cross-functional teams and actively drive product adoption across all organizational levels. 
- Hands-on experience integrating AI tools into daily workflows (e.g., for research, technical discovery, or prototyping) to boost productivity and innovation. 
- Business fluency in both English and German is required to effectively collaborate with tech teams and drive change management with local operational staff. 

What we offer Hybrid Work // Stay flexible: We embrace a hybrid working model that balances the autonomy of remote work with purposeful in-person collaboration. Ideally, you are based in Berlin or live within an easy commuting distance. While we offer flexibility, monthly presence in our office for team days, workshops, and meetings is required. Additionally, we offer you the possibility to work up to 30 days per year from selected EU countries. 

Room to grow // Stay curious: In regular/annual feedback meetings, you design your own personal development path together with your team lead. In addition, we offer an annual training budget, free access to LinkedIn Learning, as well as great workshops to seek new input and specific training for your personal development. 

Mental & physical health // Stay healthy & active: We care about your well-being and support your health with a discounted membership at Urban Sports Club. In addition, our cooperation partner "Fürstenberg Institute" is available to you and your family members with advice and support when it comes to mental health & coaching. 

Taking responsibility // We #care: We care for our planet and the people who are living on it. To make our world a little bit better, our ESG Team (Environmental, Social & Governance) promotes our awareness of environmentally friendly behavior. In addition, we work with JobRad, offer a discounted BVG ticket, and actively support social projects in Berlin at our annual Social Day to give something back. 

Teamspirit // Stay connected: What drives us is our sense of community. That's why we celebrate our Company Day once a month in our office at Potsdamer Platz, where everyone gets together in person. In addition to a comprehensive update of our C-Board, the main focus is on togetherness and the exchange of ideas over lunch and dinner together.

title: Senior Quality & Food Safety Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Come and join the leading #avoexperts 🥑 

Westfalia Fruit is a leading multinational supplier of fresh fruit and related value added products to global markets. Through our vertically-integrated supply chain we grow, source, ripen, pack, process and market quality avocadoes & fresh produce – 365 days a year & across the globe. 

With the largest avocado-growing footprint in the world, we are recognised as the leading #avoexperts , and considered as the supplier of choice to both retail & wholesale customers whom we serve from sales offices in the UK, Europe, North America, Latin America & Southern Africa. 

We value Inclusivity, Innovation, Quality, Integrity and Health & Safety. Together, we can create a thriving and positive work environment. 

We have a new opportunity for an experienced Senior Quality & Food Safety Manager to join our team in Munich, Germany on an initial 12 month contract with possibility to extend permanently. 

The Senior Quality & Food Safety Manager provides technical leadership for quality and food safety across the Munich operation. The role ensures IFS audit readiness and business continuity while strengthening the Quality and Food Safety Management System. Working with Operations, Supply Chain, suppliers, customers and international Quality functions, it drives effective controls, audit preparation and corrective action. Through documented processes, training and knowledge sharing, the role builds team capability and reduces reliance on individual knowledge holders. This is a senior specialist role without disciplinary management responsibility.

Responsibilities include: 

- Lead IFS certification readiness and coordinate internal, external and customer audits.
- Maintain and improve the Quality and Food Safety Management System.
- Review HACCP plans and food safety controls as products, suppliers and processes evolve.
- Work with Operations to strengthen hygiene, cleaning, storage and temperature controls.
- Ensure compliance with quality, food safety and customer requirements, supporting QS, BIO and GQB certifications.
- Investigate complaints and non-conformities, driving effective corrective actions.
- Manage supplier quality assessments, approval documentation and issue resolution.
- Maintain traceability and recall readiness, supporting incident investigations and product decisions.
- Monitor quality performance, report risks and drive continuous improvement.
- Train colleagues, document key processes and share expertise to strengthen team capability and business continuity.

Requirements 

Essential 

- Relevant degree or comparable qualification in food science, food technology, quality management or a related discipline.
- Several years of relevant Quality Management and Food Safety experience within the food industry, with the technical judgement to work independently at senior level.
- Strong practical IFS experience, including substantial involvement in certification preparation, audit delivery and closure of findings.
- Sound working knowledge of HACCP, food hygiene, food safety controls and Quality and Food Safety Management Systems.
- Experience conducting or coordinating audits, investigating non-conformities and complaints, and implementing effective corrective actions.
- Ability to prioritise audit and operational risks, manage competing deadlines and translate technical requirements into practical actions.
- Independent, structured and pragmatic working style, with strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to influence cross-functional colleagues, communicate risks clearly and build constructive supplier and customer relationships.
- Fluent German and English, both written and spoken.
- Ability to maintain clear documentation, share technical knowledge and support colleague development and effective handovers.

Desirable 

- Previous lead responsibility for IFS certification and audits.
- Experience in fresh food, particularly fruit and vegetables, or comparable FMCG food operations.
- Practical experience supporting QS, BIO and GQB certification requirements.
- Formal HACCP or internal/lead auditor training relevant to food safety and quality.
- Experience strengthening management systems, transferring specialist knowledge or supporting an operation through an intensive audit preparation period.
- Experience collaborating with international Quality teams and managing supplier quality or traceability exercises.
Benefits 

- Internal English course
- Professional development opportunities within the company
- Membership in the Body & Soul gym for a small fee
- Office at the Munich wholesale market near the Isar
- Competitive salary
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Free parking
- Fresh fruit and coffee specialties 

Please note that this position does not have a specific closing date. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible as we will be reviewing applications on a rolling basis and the advert may be removed at any time.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

title: Independent Consultant - Sustainable Bio-Materials & Regulatory Compliance
description:
RSB – Roundtable on Sustainable Biomaterials is a global, multi-stakeholder organisation dedicated to driving the truly sustainable development of the bioeconomy. Frequently recognised as an industry leader in supply chain sustainability, RSB applies its best-in-class sustainability framework across sectors including aviation, chemicals, materials, and shipping.

Our small, dedicated team operates remotely from countries around the world, working collaboratively with a diverse base of member organisations, industry partners, and policymakers. For more information, please visit www.rsb.org .

Purpose of This Call 

RSB now invites eligible firms and individuals (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services described below. This Call for Expressions of Interest is not yet linked to a specific project or immediate assignment . RSB is building a pre-approved External Consultant Roster: a qualified pool of selected specialists and organisations that will be called upon for project-based work for the next 2-3 years. 

We are primarily seeking to engage consultancy firms, agencies, and other established organisations, providers that can offer dedicated capacity, depth of expertise, and continuity across assignments. At the same time, we warmly welcome expressions of interest from independent consultants and other individual specialists whose qualifications and experience match the profiles sought. Throughout this document, “Consultant” refers to both firms and individuals unless stated otherwise.

Consultants accepted onto the roster will complete a brief onboarding process to become familiar with RSB’s systems, ways of working, and sustainability framework, so that engagements can begin efficiently when a relevant need is identified. When a specific project or capacity gap emerges, RSB will contact roster members whose profile best matches the assignment, share a defined scope of work, and invite them to submit a proposal.

Inclusion on the roster is an expression of readiness and fit and not a guarantee of immediate work or remuneration. 

The Services 

The Sustainable Bio-Materials & Regulatory Compliance Consultant will provide regulatory compliance and sustainability assessment expertise for bio-based materials, sustainable fuels, feedstocks and related value chains. Consultants in this profile support RSB Advisory Services with the expert practical interpretation of regulatory frameworks, such as EU RED, CORSIA and relevant voluntary certification requirements, including their GHG calculation methodologies. They support feedstock eligibility, low-ILUC considerations, sustainability-risk screening, voluntary scheme benchmarking and compliance gap identification.

Role purpose: To provide RSB with flexible, project-based technical capacity for assessing whether bio-based materials, fuels, feedstocks and supply chains meet applicable regulatory and voluntary sustainability requirements. The role helps RSB and its clients translate complex rules into defensible assessments, calculations and compliance pathways, particularly where GHG data quality, feedstock eligibility, certification readiness or regulatory interpretation are central to the assignment.

Full or partial coverage: Applicants are eligible whether they wish to cover the full scope or only a clearly defined subset of the technical areas and task requirements described below (partial coverage), based on their knowledge, skills and capabilities. Partial coverage applicants are encouraged to submit their candidacy as well.

Confidentiality: Due to non-disclosure and confidentiality commitments within RSB Advisory Services, specific project-related work cannot be attached to or disclosed in this call.

Key Responsibilities

• Contribute to narrowing and confirming the scope, system boundaries and methodological approach for assessments under EU RED, CORSIA, RSB or other relevant regulatory and voluntary sustainability frameworks.

• Review third-party-supplied GHG inventory data, apply consistency and plausibility checks, validate assumptions, clean data, identify missing or unreliable data, and propose defensible proxies or literature-based values where appropriate.

• Support or perform GHG calculations and carbon-intensity assessments using relevant or pre-defined methodologies and tools, including the RSB GHG Calculator where applicable.

• Prepare clear GHG, LCA or sustainability assessment reports using agreed templates, including methodology, assumptions, data-quality notes, result presentation and interpretation.

• Provide support for the technical understanding of sustainable bio-material pathways and low-ILUC risk considerations under EU RED, CORSIA, RSB or equivalent requirements.

• Support regulatory and voluntary-scheme gap analyses by participating in the documentation of benchmarking requirements, identifying, verifying or validating compliance risks, and reviewing third-party organisational documentation against criteria (met, not met or not applicable).

• Review certification-readiness documentation under RSB guidance, including evidence related to feedstock origin, traceability, chain of custody, sustainability criteria and GHG claims.

• Support the interpretation of policy or regulatory requirements for specific feedstocks, technologies, products or markets by providing supporting data and literature reviews, and translate findings into practical compliance options in line with the applicable standard requirements.

• Support the development or refinement of methodologies, blueprints and decision tools for innovative sustainability assessments involving bio-based materials, fuels, chemicals or emerging feedstock pathways. 

Requirements 

Essential (all applicants, firms and individuals, must meet these criteria): 

• Strong written and spoken English proficiency.

• Ability to maintain regular availability overlapping with CET working hours of a minimum of 4 hours per day.

• Proven output/delivery track record in your area of expertise.

• Full compliance with all applicable local laws and regulations, including tax and social security obligations, and legal authorisation to perform consultancy services in the country of residence or operation.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills, the ability to operate autonomously, and a proactive approach to communicating progress, risks, and opportunities in a clear and constructive manner.

• Self-sufficiency in a remote and fully digital working environment with reliable internet connectivity. Video calls and collaborative tools will be used for coordination.

Specific to this profile: 

• Proven hands-on experience applying EU RED, CORSIA, RSB or equivalent GHG and sustainability methodologies in client, certification, policy or project-development contexts.

• Working knowledge of at least one major voluntary sustainability certification scheme, preferably RSB, ISCC or another scheme relevant to biofuels, SAF, biomass or bio-based materials.

• Demonstrated ability to assess feedstock eligibility, GHG data quality, certification readiness or regulatory compliance for specific products, pathways or supply chains.

• Ability to work independently with limited onboarding, document assumptions transparently and flag uncertainty, data gaps and compliance risks.

• Strong written English and effective reporting skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong communication skills and comfort working with client-provided data under confidentiality constraints.

• CET ±5 hours time-zone compatibility, unless otherwise agreed for a specific assignment.

For firms / agencies: 

• Ability to assign appropriately qualified personnel to assignments and to ensure continuity of delivery, including cover for absences.

• Confirmation that the named individuals proposed for RSB assignments meet the essential criteria above.

Desirable (will strengthen your Expression of Interest): 

• Working knowledge of the RSB standard and certification system in particular, or of ISCC.

• Hands-on experience using the RSB GHG Calculator.

• Experience developing or refining methodologies, blueprints or decision tools for emerging feedstock pathways, bio-based materials, fuels or chemicals.

Indicative Outputs (may include but are not limited to): 
Specific deliverables, estimated time input, and project duration will be clarified in the Terms of Reference (TOR) issued to shortlisted roster members when a project need is identified. 

• Scoping notes defining system boundaries and the methodological approach for an assessment

• GHG data review and validation notes (plausibility checks, data gaps, proposed proxies or literature values)

• GHG calculations and carbon-intensity assessments (including RSB GHG Calculator outputs)

• GHG, LCA or sustainability assessment reports based on agreed templates

• Feedstock eligibility and low-ILUC risk assessments

• Regulatory and voluntary-scheme benchmarking and gap analyses

• Certification-readiness reviews and evidence/documentation checks

• Policy and regulatory interpretation notes and literature reviews with practical compliance options

Methodologies, blueprints and decision tools for innovative sustainability assessments

Benefits 

Working with RSB offers the opportunity to contribute to a globally recognised organisation at the forefront of sustainability and systems transformation. 

· Meaningful, mission-driven work: Contribute to advancing sustainability standards and real-world impact across global value chains, influencing how industries operate and evolve.

· Flexible, high-impact assignments: Participate in intellectually engaging, project-based work that allows you to apply your expertise to real-world challenges.

· Opportunity for ongoing collaboration: Consultants on the roster may be engaged on multiple assignments, fostering longer-term professional relationships with RSB.

______________________________________

Submission deadline: 24 October 2026 

Type of Engagement: Project-based (as required) with an overarching Framework Agreement

Preferred Provider Type: Independent consultants and individuals, firms, agencies, and established organisations.

Remuneration: Agreed day rate

Location: Remote

Framework Agreement Duration: Until September 2028 [2 years], unless a Consultant or RSB request removal or changes to Framework Agreement.

Working Hours / Time Zone: CET ±4 hours time-zone compatibility, unless otherwise agreed for a specific assignment (minimum 4 hours per day overlapping with CET working hours).

Roster Launch: November 2026

_________________________________________

Diversity & Inclusion 

RSB is committed to fostering diversity and inclusion across all its work. We strongly encourage expressions of interest from individuals and firms representing underrepresented groups, including, but not limited to, women, persons from the Global South, persons with disabilities, and members of other historically marginalised communities. We believe that diverse perspectives strengthen the quality and relevance of our work.

Conflict of Interest 

Applicants must disclose any actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest at the time of expression of interest and throughout the engagement. A conflict of interest exists where the Consultant has personal, professional, or financial relationships that could impair objectivity or create unfair advantage.

Anti-Corruption & Integrity 

RSB operates a zero-tolerance policy with respect to fraud, bribery, corruption, and any other form of misconduct. All Consultants are expected to adhere to the highest ethical standards and to comply with applicable anti-corruption laws. Any breach may result in immediate termination and referral to relevant authorities.

As a Data Platform Engineer, you will be responsible for building and evolving modern cloud platforms for Data & AI. Together with our team and our clients, you will develop platforms that can be operated in a scalable, secure, and sustainable manner.

In doing so, you will combine cloud infrastructure, platform architecture, and modern Data & AI technologies into solutions that create a stable foundation for analytics, data engineering, and AI use cases.

title: Head of Product & Technology (AI) (m/w/d)
description:
Auf einen Blick Arbeitsort: deutschlandweit oder in einem unserer Büros in München und Berlin
Arbeitsmodell: Remote deutschlandweit und zusätzlich bis zu drei Monate pro Jahr innerhalb Europas.

Warum gibt es diese Stelle? PIABO entwickelt eine eigene Softwareplattform, die internes Wissen und Abläufe für die Teams nutzbar macht. Erste Anwendungen sind bereits im Einsatz. Unser Anspruch ist, daraus ein verlässliches Produktportfolio zu entwickeln: Lösungen, die im Arbeitsalltag genutzt werden, einen nachvollziehbaren Nutzen stiften und sich bei belegter Wirkung für weitere Teams, Kundenprojekte oder neue Angebote eignen.

Damit diese Entwicklung gelingt, braucht es klare Entscheidungen darüber, welche Probleme Priorität haben und welche Lösungen verlässlich in den Einsatz kommen. Die Rolle verbindet Produkt- und Technologieentwicklung, gibt dem bestehenden fünfköpfigen Team aus Development und Project Management eine gemeinsame Richtung und verantwortet zugleich PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft.

Drei Must-haves für die Stelle - Produkt- und Business-Urteil: Du verbindest Produktentscheidungen mit konkretem Geschäftsnutzen.
- Hands-on Engineering: Du bringst eigene Entwicklungserfahrung mit und beurteilst technische Qualität praktisch.
- Führung und operative Verantwortung: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Führung und einen verlässlichen IT-Betrieb.

Was du bei uns tust und wie - Portfolio und Priorisierung: Du berätst die Geschäftsführung zu Produkt- und Technologieentscheidungen. Du bewertest Vorhaben nach Geschäftswirkung, Machbarkeit, Risiken und Kapazität und übersetzt priorisierte Themen in realistische Umsetzungsetappen. Wenn Nutzen oder Voraussetzungen nicht tragen, machst du das transparent und empfiehlst Alternativen.
- Use Cases und Erfolgskriterien: Gemeinsam mit den nutzenden Teams nimmst du konkrete Abläufe und Probleme auf, grenzt den Bedarf ein und legst fest, welchen Nutzen die Lösung schaffen soll und woran erfolgreiche Nutzung erkennbar wird.
- Software entwickeln: Du baust selbst Prototypen und produktive Software mit AI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen, darunter Coding Agents und LLM-APIs. Du testest Annahmen früh und führst tragfähige Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz.
- Technische Qualität sichern: Du verantwortest technische Konzepte und Qualitätsmaßstäbe: von Architektur, APIs, Datenflüssen und Integrationen bis zu Tests, Code-Reviews, Dokumentation und Übergabe in den Betrieb.
- Team führen und entwickeln: Du führst das fünfköpfige Team aus Development und Project Management disziplinarisch. Du setzt gemeinsame Prioritäten und Qualitätsmaßstäbe, gibst Feedback und entwickelst Zusammenarbeit und fachliche Stärke weiter.

Daraus leitest du ab, was weiterentwickelt, skaliert oder beendet wird.
- Operative IT verantworten: Du verantwortest PIABOs operative IT- und Tool-Landschaft und koordinierst die zuständigen internen und externen Spezialist:innen. Du hältst Zuständigkeiten für verlässlichen Betrieb, Zugriffe, Security und Datenschutz klar und sorgst dafür, dass Fragen mit der nötigen Expertise bearbeitet werden.

Das bringst du mit Die folgenden Erfahrungen sind für die Rolle erforderlich; unterschiedliche Karrierewege können passen: - Du bringst mindestens zehn Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Software- und Produktentwicklung sowie mehrere Jahre eigene Entwicklungspraxis mit – zum Beispiel mit Node.js/TypeScript, Python oder Go. Du hast produktive Systeme selbst gebaut und betrieben.
- Du arbeitest täglich mit Coding Agents und LLM-APIs (Agentic Engineering) und kannst ihre Leistungsfähigkeit und Grenzen einschätzen.
- Du hast mindestens ein digitales Produkt von der Idee bis in den Betrieb verantwortet. An einem konkreten Beispiel kannst du zeigen, wie du bei offenen Anforderungen Vision, Roadmap und Prioritäten festgelegt, die Lösung in produktive Nutzung gebracht und anhand messbarer Ergebnisse die nächsten Schritte gesteuert hast.
- Du hast ein Team disziplinarisch geführt und Mitarbeitende fachlich weiterentwickelt. Du arbeitest mit Geschäftsführung, Projektmanagement und Development auf Augenhöhe und challengst Anforderungen, wenn sie nicht zum Ziel beitragen.
- Du hast den IT-Betrieb selbst verantwortet oder eng gesteuert – einschließlich Security, Zugriffsmanagement und Datenschutz.
- Du sprichst fließend Deutsch (C1) und sehr gut Englisch (B2).

Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss - Du hast als CTO oder CPO in einem Startup gearbeitet oder ein technisches Unternehmen mit aufgebaut.
- Du hast AI-Produkte oder -Plattformen über mehrere Geschäftsbereiche hinweg in die Nutzung gebracht oder skaliert.
- Du hast SaaS-Produkte oder wiederverwendbare Software für Kundenprojekte verantwortet.

What’s in it for you? Du steigst in ein bestehendes AI-Produktsetup ein: Erste Anwendungen sind im Einsatz und ein fünfköpfiges Team ist vorhanden. So kannst du die nächste Entwicklungsstufe mitgestalten, statt bei null anzufangen. - Nähe zur Geschäftsführung: Du tauschst dich direkt mit der Geschäftsführung aus und bringst deine Empfehlungen zu Produkt- und Technologieentscheidungen ein.
- Business Impact: Deine Arbeit wirkt in PIABOs internen Abläufen, im New Business, in Kundenprojekten und in neuen Leistungsangeboten.
- AI-Lernen: AI Bootcamp, moderner Tech Stack und Raum, AI in der eigenen Arbeit praktisch einzusetzen.
- Umfeld: Eine Organisation, die etabliert und zugleich beweglich ist und AI als Grundlage für Produkte, Prozesse und Zusammenarbeit versteht.

title: Product Designer (m/f/d) — Energy Insights
description:

You'll be the only designer on this team, working directly with a PM, engineers, and our customer success team. Much of the work is improving and reshaping features we already have, so you'll be making existing things clearer and more useful as well as designing new ones.

- Design data-dense interfaces (load profiles, consumption breakdowns, anomalies) that stay readable for people who aren't data analysts

- Design internal tools for our customer success and onboarding teams. They're users too.

- An early-stage mindset — priorities shift as we learn, and you treat ambiguity as something to work through, not around

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.

Why This Role Matters You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on - Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
- Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
- Cloud infrastructure on GCP . Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
- Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

What Sets You Up for Success Must have: - At least 6–8 years building and running backend systems in production, including real time in a platform or infrastructure role that other engineers depended on
- Strong backend engineering in TypeScript. You have designed, shipped and operated services and APIs in it — not just touched it around the edges of a frontend
- Hands-on with Kafka in production. Topic design, consumer groups, ordering and delivery guarantees, and what you actually do at 3am when a consumer group is hours behind. A comparable streaming platform is fine if you know it at that depth
- Solid on GCP or an equivalent cloud: containers, networking and IAM basics, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting. You have owned infrastructure, not just deployed onto it
- Comfortable with high-volume time-series data: ingestion, data quality, backfills, and the everyday reality of late, missing and duplicated readings
- You have seen a few things. Enough production years behind you to know which trade-offs come back to bite, when the boring option is the right one, and how to make a call with incomplete information instead of waiting for certainty
- Kubernetes knowledge at the level of running it, not only deploying to it.
- Clear written and spoken English. German is a plus
Nice to have: - Energy, industrial, IoT or another domain where the data comes off real hardware
- Metering or device protocols, telemetry at scale, or streaming pipelines
- Knowledge of a second programming language, like Python, Go or Kotlin
- You run what you build: monitoring, alerting, and the occasional early morning debugging a pipeline

What You Get - Top-of-market team, flat hierarchy — work alongside people who push you to get better
- Competitive salary
- Full ownership from day one — you actively shape our company

- Wellpass membership

title: Chief of Staff (m/w/x)
description:
About Doctorflix Medizin entwickelt sich schneller als je zuvor, und Ärzte müssen ihr ganzes Berufsleben lang mithalten. Doctorflix ist die digitale Plattform, auf der Ärzte im deutschsprachigen Raum lernen: kostenlos, zertifiziert und mit dem größten Angebot im Markt. Weil wir dort sind, wo Ärzte ihr Wissen auf den neuesten Stand bringen, sind wir auch der Kanal, über den Pharma- und MedTech-Unternehmen sie relevant erreichen. Unsere Vision: die führende Plattform für medizinisches Wissen zu werden, zuerst in DACH, dann international. Ein Ort, an dem Ärzte lernen, sich austauschen und bessere Entscheidungen für ihre Patienten treffen. Wir sind ein VC-finanziertes Startup aus Berlin und wachsen organisch wie anorganisch.

Role Wir sind aus der frühen Startup-Phase herausgewachsen: ein neues Sales-Team, neue Produkte, anorganisches Wachstum in Vorbereitung, der Schritt ins Ausland in Sicht. Was uns jetzt bremst, sind nicht fehlende Ideen, sondern Prozesse, die nicht mitwachsen.

Als Chief of Staff arbeitest du direkt mit unseren Gründern Hans und Leo und machst aus Strategie ein laufendes System. Du baust unsere Operations so um, dass sie bei doppelter Größe noch funktionieren, automatisierst, was kein Mensch mehr tun sollte, und übernimmst die Projekte, die über unser nächstes Jahr entscheiden.

Das ist weder eine Assistenzrolle noch ein reiner Strategie-Job. Du schreibst nicht die Folie über den Prozess. Du baust den Prozess und, wo es Sinn ergibt, den Agenten, der ihn ausführt.

Your tasks Operations & Organisation für Scale 

- Du nimmst unsere Kernprozesse auseinander (Angebot bis Rechnung, Kampagnen-Go-live, Content-Produktion, Reporting) und baust sie neu: klare Ownership, saubere Übergaben, messbare Durchlaufzeiten.
- Du etablierst unseren Operating Rhythm: OKR-Prozess mit Owner pro Key Result, Leadership-Meetings, KPI-Reviews, nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen.
- Du professionalisierst die Organisation: Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, ein Tool-Stack, der zusammenspielt (ClickUp, Notion, Metabase, CRM), und genau die Regeln, die wir brauchen. Nicht mehr.
- Gemeinsam mit Finance und externen Partnern machst du Backoffice-Prozesse wie Rechnungsstellung, Forderungsmanagement und Abschluss-Zulieferung robust.
Automatisierung & AI-Workflows 

- Du verantwortest unsere AI-native-Agenda: In jedem Team identifizierst du die Workflows mit dem größten Hebel, automatisierst sie und misst die Wirkung (Zeit, Fehlerquote, Durchlaufzeit).
- Du baust selbst: Agenten und Automationen mit LLM-APIs (z. B. Claude), n8n, Make oder Zapier, Skripten und Schnittstellen zwischen unseren Systemen. Bei größeren Vorhaben steuerst du Product und Engineering.
- Du sorgst dafür, dass jede Automation dokumentiert ist, überwacht wird und einen Owner hat, statt nach drei Monaten still kaputtzugehen.
Strategische Sonderprojekte 

- M&A & Post-Merger-Integration: Du begleitest Zukäufe von der Due Diligence bis zur Integration. Teams, Kunden, Plattformen, Inhalte und Prozesse führst du mit einem 100-Tage-Plan und klaren Synergiezielen zusammen.
- Internationalisierung: Du bereitest den Markteintritt außerhalb von DACH vor: Business Case, Markt- und Partneranalyse, operatives Playbook.
- Themen, die heute niemand im Team ownt, die aber jemand ownen muss.
Führung 

- Du führst Teams und Projektgruppen bereichsübergreifend, je nach Phase auch interimistisch, etwa ein integriertes Team nach einem Zukauf.
- Du forderst Teamleads heraus, ambitionierte Ziele zu setzen, und hältst nach, dass sie erreicht werden.
Fundraising & Investor Relations 

- Du unterstützt die Gründer bei Finanzierungsrunden: Equity Story, Finanzmodell, Datenraum, Due-Diligence-Fragen.
- Du verantwortest Board-Unterlagen und das monatliche Investoren-Reporting inhaltlich mit.

Your profile - Operator: Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, davon mehrere Jahre in operativer Verantwortung, z. B. in Operations, BizOps oder Founder's Office eines Scale-ups, als Gründer oder nach einem Start in Beratung, PE oder VC mit Wechsel ins Operative. Du hast Operations nachweislich auf- oder umgebaut, nicht nur analysiert.
- Automator: Du kannst konkrete Prozesse zeigen, die du automatisiert hast, mit Vorher und Nachher. Du arbeitest sicher mit Low-Code-Tools und APIs. SQL oder Python sind ein Plus.
- AI-native: Du nutzt AI nicht als besseres Google. Du hast Workflows gebaut, in denen LLMs echte Arbeit übernehmen (Agenten, Integrationen, Kontext- und Prompt-Design, Qualitätskontrolle), und weißt, wo sie scheitern.
- Analytisch & strukturiert: Du zerlegst unklare Probleme schnell, rechnest Business Cases selbst und entscheidest auf Basis von Daten, auch wenn sie unvollständig sind.
- Führung: Du hast Teams oder bereichsübergreifende Projekte geführt und bringst Menschen dazu mitzuziehen, auch ohne disziplinarische Linie.
- Doctorflix-DNA: Drive (du willst das Ergebnis und gehst dafür die Extrameile), Hands-on (Pragmatismus vor Perfektion), Proaktivität (du wartest nicht auf Aufträge) und eine Neugier, von der das Team etwas lernen kann.
- Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch fließend.

Why us? - Hebel: Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Einblick in Board, Investoren und M&A. Entscheidungen fallen in Tagen, nicht in Quartalen.
- Impact: Unsere Fortbildungen erreichen Zehntausende Ärzte in DACH und damit die Versorgung ihrer Patienten.
- Entwicklung: Die Rolle ist ein Sprungbrett. Je nachdem, wie du und das Unternehmen sich entwickeln, kann daraus eine Leitungsrolle werden, etwa in Operations oder für einen neuen Markt.
- Spielraum für AI: Freiheit, neue Tools zu testen und einzuführen.
- Benefits: Attraktives Gehaltspaket inkl. Aktienpaket (VSOP) sowie Urban Sports Club.

title: Junior Talent Acquisition Partner (m/w/d)
description:
Davon träumen wir: Mehr als Recruiting. Die richtigen Menschen für die richtigen Aufgaben. 

VielfaltMenü befindet sich in einer Phase der Weiterentwicklung. Wir schärfen unsere Organisation, professionalisieren unsere Prozesse und richten uns noch konsequenter auf unsere Kund:innen, unsere Mitarbeiter:innen und nachhaltiges Wachstum aus. 
Dazu gehört auch ein neues Verständnis von Recruiting. 
Wir wollen Stellen nicht einfach besetzen. Wir wollen verstehen, welche Kompetenzen wir wirklich benötigen, wie wir sie erkennen und welche Menschen zu unserer Organisation und unseren Zielen passen. 

Dafür suchen wir dich als Junior Talent Acquisition Partner:in 

Du musst nicht bereits zehn Jahre Recruiting-Erfahrung mitbringen. 
Entscheidend sind für uns analytisches Denken, Neugier, ein ausgeprägter Qualitätsanspruch und die Fähigkeit, Menschen und Kompetenzen gut einzuschätzen. 

Deine Aufgaben 
Du begleitest Recruitingprozesse von der ersten Anforderungsanalyse bis zum unterschriebenen Arbeitsvertrag und entwickelst gemeinsam mit People & Culture unsere Recruitingstandards weiter. 
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Führungskräften und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. 
Talent Acquisition & Beratung 
Du führst strukturierte Briefings mit Führungskräften und übersetzt Anforderungen in klare Kompetenz- und Kandidatenprofile. 
Du berätst Führungskräfte bei der Auswahl geeigneter Kandidat:innen und sprichst auch dann eine klare Empfehlung aus, wenn die einfachste Lösung nicht die beste ist. 
Interviews führst du eigenständig – vom operativen Recruiting bis hin zu Gesprächen auf Managementebene. 
Kompetenzorientierte Auswahl 
Wir wollen Auswahlentscheidungen stärker auf Kompetenzen und nachvollziehbare Kriterien stützen. 
Du entwickelst strukturierte Interviewleitfäden, Bewertungsmatrizen und Auswahlstandards und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Entscheidungen vergleichbarer und belastbarer werden. 
Bei diagnostischen Auswahlverfahren und Assessments begleitest du Konzeption, Durchführung und Auswertung. 
Dein Anspruch dabei: weniger Bauchgefühl, mehr Qualität in der Entscheidung . 
Candidate Experience & Kreativität 
Professionelle Prozesse dürfen trotzdem persönlich sein. 
Du entwickelst Ideen, wie wir Kandidat:innen besser erreichen und ihnen vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Einstellung eine überzeugende Candidate Experience bieten. 
Dabei probierst du neue Recruitingwege aus, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns moderne Recruitingformate. 
Vertragsmanagement & Prozesse 
Du steuerst den Recruitingprozess zuverlässig bis zum Vertragsabschluss. 
Du bereitest Vertragsangebote vor, koordinierst Abstimmungen und sorgst dafür, dass Vereinbarungen vollständig, korrekt und termingerecht umgesetzt werden. 
Arbeitsrechtliche und datenschutzrechtliche Fragestellungen erkennst du und kannst sie gemeinsam mit People & Culture bzw. unserer juristischen Expertise einordnen. 
Du arbeitest strukturiert, standardisiert und detailgenau – ohne dabei unnötige Bürokratie aufzubauen. 

Was du mitbringst 
Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftspsychologie, Psychologie, Personalmanagement, Wirtschafts- oder Rechtswissenschaften, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. 
Erste praktische Erfahrung im Recruiting, Talent Acquisition, HR oder in der Personalauswahl ist hilfreich – beispielsweise durch Werkstudententätigkeiten, Praktika oder deine erste berufliche Station. 
Auch wenn du am Anfang deiner Karriere stehst, freuen wir uns ausdrücklich auf deine Bewerbung. 
Wichtiger als die Anzahl deiner Berufsjahre ist für uns, wie du denkst und arbeitest. 
Du hast Interesse an eignungsdiagnostischen und kompetenzorientierten Auswahlverfahren. 
Du kannst Gespräche strukturieren, genau zuhören, kritisch nachfragen und deine Einschätzung anschließend nachvollziehbar begründen. 
Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und keine Scheu davor, mit Führungskräften und Geschäftsführung auf Augenhöhe zu diskutieren. 
Juristische Fragestellungen – insbesondere rund um Arbeitsverträge und Arbeitsrecht – schrecken dich nicht ab. Idealerweise bringst du bereits entsprechende Grundkenntnisse mit. 
Du arbeitest sehr sorgfältig und hast gleichzeitig Freude daran, Dinge neu zu denken. 

Was uns bei dir besonders wichtig ist 
Kreativität . 
Du akzeptierst nicht automatisch, dass Recruiting so funktionieren muss, wie es schon immer funktioniert hat. 
Struktur. 
Du glaubst an Standards, klare Prozesse und nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen. 
Detailorientierung. 
Ein falsches Datum im Arbeitsvertrag ist für dich keine Kleinigkeit. 
Urteilsvermögen. 
Du möchtest verstehen, welche Kompetenzen jemand wirklich mitbringt – und nicht nur, wie gut sich jemand präsentieren kann. 
Mut zur Empfehlung. 
Von dir erwarten wir nicht nur Organisation. Wir wollen deine Einschätzung hören. 
Neugier. 
Du möchtest verstehen, wie unser Geschäft funktioniert und was unsere Führungskräfte und Teams erfolgreich macht. 

Was dich bei VielfaltMenü erwartet 
VielfaltMenü steht für „Mehr als gutes Essen.“ 
Wir versorgen täglich Menschen in Bildungseinrichtungen und entwickeln uns als Unternehmen kontinuierlich weiter. People & Culture soll dabei nicht nur verwalten, sondern die Entwicklung des Unternehmens aktiv unterstützen. Du bekommst deshalb die Möglichkeit, unser Recruiting nicht nur auszuführen, sondern mitzugestalten . Du arbeitest eng mit Führungskräften, dem People & Culture-Team sowie der Geschäftsführung zusammen und erhältst früh Verantwortung für eigene Recruitingprozesse. Gleichzeitig geben wir dir Raum, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. 
In deiner Rolle genießt du echten Gestaltungsspielraum : Du baust moderne Qualitäts- sowie Prozessstrukturen aktiv mit auf und prägst die Standards eines führenden Unternehmens für Kita- und Schulverpflegung in Deutschland. Dabei profitierst du von kurzen Entscheidungswegen und einer Geschäftsführung, die Qualität strategisch fördert. 
Neben einem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag in einem zukunftssicheren Markt erwarten dich eine attraktive, transparente Vergütung sowie klare Entwicklungsperspektiven durch strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Weiterbildungen. Wir unterstützen deine Work-Life-Balance durch 30 Urlaubstage , geregelte Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten. Zudem erhältst du moderne Arbeitsmittel inklusive Diensthandy. Eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung und ein engagiertes, kollegiales Team runden unser Angebot ab. 

Klingt nach dir? 
Dann interessiert uns nicht nur dein Lebenslauf. 
Wir möchten wissen, wie du über Menschen, Kompetenzen und gute Personalauswahl denkst. 
Bewirb dich bei uns und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns, wie Recruiting bei VielfaltMenü künftig funktioniert. 

VielfaltMenü – Mehr als gutes Essen.

description:
About us

Netlight provides a full range of premium IT-consulting services at the forefront of the digital industry and stands out for its product- and technology-independent expertise in a wide range of industries and clients. We are a network organization of more than 2 000 role models making aspiring digital leaders successful in their business-critical IT projects. Netlight has been awarded several times as top employer, as well as for growth, continued profitability and engagement for diversity, equity and equality within the IT industry. Today we are growing all across Europe, currently with more than 13 active international offices.

The role

As a Senior AI/ML Consultant, you are the person clients trust to turn AI ambition into production reality. You design and build AI systems that hold up beyond the demo. Machine learning pipelines, generative AI solutions, and the technical foundations that let organisations extract real value from AI.

Our consultants bring varied paths and perspectives to this work. What unites them is a principled approach to system design, a genuine curiosity about the business problems behind each model, seeing work through from the first experiment to a system running in production. Across engagements, you may work as an ML engineer, AI architect, LLM/GenAI specialist, or a strategic advisor, often a combination of several within one engagement.

What the work looks like

Building AI systems, shaping strategy. You design, build, and operationalise AI systems across the full stack, from data pipelines and feature engineering to LLM applications, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. You use MLOps practices to bring models into production reliably and keep them there. And you work with clients to make the decisions that matter: build versus buy, model selection, responsible AI, and the organisational change that turns AI from a pilot into a practice.

title: Data Platform & Data Architecture Consultant
description:
About the role

As a Data Platform & Data Architecture Consultant , you are the person clients trust to turn their data infrastructure from a bottleneck into a competitive advantage. You design data landscapes, stand up and scale cloud data platforms, and set the guardrails that let entire organisations build on data safely and efficiently.

Our consultants bring varied paths and perspectives to this work. What unites them is structural thinking, a drive to understand the business context behind every technical decision, and the ability to operate across both the blueprint and the build. Across engagements, you may operate as a data architect, lead a platform build, or contribute at the strategic advisory level, often blending several of these roles within a single engagement.

What the work looks like

Building and operating platforms. You design, provision, and harden cloud data platforms end to end, covering storage and compute, networking, security and IAM, observability, and cost. You codify infrastructure using tools like Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation and establish governance frameworks such as data catalogs, data contracts, RBAC models, and SLAs that let organisations scale data access without losing control. You build platforms that multiple teams and business domains can rely on, not just at launch, but as they grow.

Shaping the data architecture. You design logical and physical data models, map data flows and lineage across systems, and make the structural decisions that determine how data is organised, integrated, and consumed. This can mean designing a target-state architecture for a client migrating from legacy systems to a modern cloud lakehouse, or defining domain boundaries and data product interfaces in a data mesh adoption.

Advising and translating. You sit at the intersection of technology and business. You work with data engineers, data scientists, product owners, and senior client stakeholders to understand what they need, then turn that into platform strategy and architecture decisions. You are the person a CTO trusts to make the right call on how their data infrastructure should evolve.

Minimum Qualifications 

- Master’s Degree in Engineering or Technology (e.g., Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or similar) 

- Verbal and written fluency in English 

- 2–4 years of full-time work experience in cloud data infrastructure, data platform engineering, or data architecture. Experience working in agile product or delivery teams, gained after completing your Master's degree 

- Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including compute, storage, networking, and identity management 

- Practical experience with at least one modern cloud data platform such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift, or Microsoft Fabric 

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation) and modern CI/CD and DevOps workflows 

- Experience with data modeling, data architecture, or designing data flows and integration patterns across systems 

- Experience designing or operating data governance, security controls, and platform observability in environments serving multiple teams or domains 

- Demonstrated ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders including engineers, analysts, product owners, and business leaders in client-facing settings

Preferred Qualifications 

- Experience with data mesh, data product, or data lakehouse architectures at an organisational level 

- Depth in enterprise data architecture, including conceptual, logical, and physical modeling, data lineage, and approaches such as dimensional modeling or Data Vault 

- Hands-on experience with multi-tenant platform design or multi-cloud environments 

- Familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker) in data platform contexts
